sp-04174.description_en: As SpectJLCrearure Z, except the chance is

sp-04181.description_en: This spell is cast before a Summoning spell (that cannot be higher than 10th level) is cast. It will delay the arrival of the summoned creatures up to 1 day per level of the caster or until triggered by one of the following (decided at the time of casting): specified movements, touch, or a specific action. The caster may specify (at the time of casting) a single task for the creature(s) to perform when it (they) arrive.

sp-04182.description_en: Caster can quadruple the range of any active Control or Mastery spell.

sp-04183.description_en: As Potent Summons, except the modifier is +20.

sp-04184.description_en: As Legion, except controlled creature only requires 10% activity to control.

sp-04186.description_en: Caster can quintuple the range of any active Control or Mastery spell.

sp-04187.description_en: Summons True - As Waiting Summons. except it can be cast with any level Summons spell.

sp-04188.description_en: Caster gains permanent control of the next creature he summons and controls. This creature will receive a RR against this spell. If the creature fails the RR, it is permanently bound to the caster's plane, and is placed under the control of the caster and will unfailingly obey him. The caster can have as many of these creatures under his control as he wishes.

sp-04213.description_en: All of target's RR's suffer a penalty of -5 for the duration.

sp-04219.description_en: All of target's RRs suffer a penalty of -10 for the duration.

sp-04225.description_en: All of target's RRs suffer a penalty of -15 for the duration.

sp-04231.description_en: All of target's RRs suffer a penalty of -25 for the duration.

sp-04234.description_en: Caster can use any one of the lower level spells on this list once per round.

sp-04327.description_en: This spell allows the caster to determine if a particular location, object, or person has any kind of connection with the caster's fate. A connection with the caster's fate is anything that the caster would consider important to his future.

sp-04328.description_en: Caster causes any fate, omen reading, or other such spells to fail on him when tried.

sp-04329.description_en: Caster improves his luck for one action. This spell may only be cast once per action that requires a die roll. The die roll has +1 added to it (and this modification may make the roll openended). This spell may not be cast after the dice are rolled, does not require any separate action or activity, and it is considered part of the action that is being resolved.

sp-04330.description_en: Caster is able to determine the target's remaining Fate Points. If the target makes his RR, or cancels this spell, the caster will still know whether or not the target has any Fate Points at all.

sp-04331.description_en: Caster places a blessing on the target. Target gains a special bonus of +lO on his next action.

sp-04332.description_en: Caster worsens the luck of the target. The target suffers a special penalty of -1 per level of the caster for all his actions.

sp-04333.description_en: Caster alters his own luck. After caster's next action and dice roll are made, he may choose which die is the “tens” die and which one is the “ones” die.

sp-04334.description_en: Predicts the most probable actions of the target in the next round; specifics are not learned (e.g., attack in melee, cast a spell; but no detail on targets or what spell). This results in the caster being able to declare his statement of intent after hearing what the target has decided to do.

sp-04335.description_en: Causes the caster to be excluded from random rolls made concerning a group of which the caster is a member. If the GM rolls randomly for the group concerning encounters, surprise attacks, random spell effects, random choosing of targets, etc., the caster is excluded from all such rolls, and his presence does not affect his group's rolls.

sp-04336.description_en: Caster causes terrible luck to come upon one target. Causes the target's next action to be resolved as if he rolled a 01.

sp-04337.description_en: Caster's luck versus one spell is altered. Caster may reroll any one RR within the duration.

sp-04338.description_en: As LuckZ, except roll is modified by +2.

sp-04339.description_en: Caster gains a Fate Point. This can only be done once per level.

sp-04340.description_en: Caster separates one target from destiny. This causes the target to lose one Fate Point.

sp-04341.description_en: Caster alters his own fate. Caster can cause any one roll made within the duration that is directly related to him to be rerolled.

sp-04342.description_en: next action to be modified by +dlOO.

sp-04343.description_en: As LuckZ, except roll is modified by +3.

sp-04344.description_en: Caster gains a +1 per level bonus to the next Divine Intervention maneuver that he makes.

sp-04346.description_en: Brings horrible luck to the target. Causes all the target's actions to be treated as if he rolled a 01.

sp-04347.description_en: Causes the target's next action to be resolved as if the target rolled a 100.

sp-04753.description_en: caster, and adds 5 to all of the caster's RRs versus spells. If the spells are cast by a Channeling spell user that is a member of the caster's current studied faith (see “The Mask” spell list), the bonuses become +lO.

sp-04754.description_en: For the duration, the caster receives a special bonus of +15 to any fear RRs.

sp-04755.description_en: For the duration, the caster receives a special bonus of +15 to any poison RRs.

sp-04756.description_en: Creates an invisible force shield in front of the caster. This functions as a normal shield (subtracting 25 from appropriate attacks, etc.), except it does not occupy a hand. This spell cannot be combined with a real shield.

sp-04757.description_en: As Protection Z, except the bonuses are +lO and + 15 respectively.

sp-04758.description_en: Grants +lO DB versus melee and missile attacks. Not cumulative with Aura or Blur spells.

sp-04759.description_en: Caster can deflect any one missile that passes within 10 feet of him (caster must be able to see the missile). This causes 100 to be subtracted from the missile's attack.

sp-04760.description_en: Caster's clothing is enchanted to protect as AT 3.

sp-04761.description_en: Caster can deflect any one melee attack that he can see (and is within range). This causes 50 to be subtracted from the attack.

sp-04763.description_en: For the duration, the caster gains a bonus of +30 against any attempts by others to convert him. The same bonus applies to the caster's RRs vs. spells of any other religion that attempt to convert or corrupt him.

sp-04764.description_en: Caster's clothing is enchanted to protect as AT 8.

sp-04765.description_en: As Deflections Z, except affects two missiles.

sp-04766.description_en: As Combat Defense Z, except the bonus is +15.

sp-04768.description_en: As Bladeturn Z, except affects two attacks.

sp-04769.description_en: Caster's clothing is enchanted to protect as AT 12.

sp-04770.description_en: Gives the caster a bonus of +20 against any Absolution spells or against any Black Channel spells. This bonus is cumulative with other protection spells.

sp-04771.description_en: As Combat DefenseZ, except the bonus is +20.

sp-04772.description_en: Caster's clothing is enchanted to protect as AT 20.

sp-04773.description_en: As Protection Z, except the bonuses are +30 and +50. respectively.

sp-04774.description_en: As Combat Defense I, except the bonus is +30.

sp-04775.description_en: Caster can use any lower level spell on this list once per round.

sp-04821.description_en: Adds +l 0 to one maneuver the round after this spell is cast. No other action can be performed until this maneuver is resolved.

sp-04822.description_en: Caster is healed of one area of up to mild frostbite or first degree burns.

sp-04823.description_en: Caster can ignore up to -10 in accrued penalties from injuries or concussion hit loss.

sp-03883.description_en: Caster learns whether there are any magical gates, teleportals. or other magical portals in the area of effect.

sp-03884.description_en: This spell will only work between the time a summons spell has been cast, and when the creature arrives. It allows the caster to prevent a creature from arriving if it fails its RR for this spell. This spell will only work on creatures that are fourth level or less.

sp-03887.description_en: Places a barrier in front of a gate, teleportal, or other magical portal. To cross the gate, a being must make an RR versus the level of the caster or take a 'B Impact critical and not pass through the gate.

sp-03888.description_en: creatures that are eighth level or less.

sp-03889.description_en: As Break Control Z, except it will also break the control of any Mastery spell.

sp-03890.description_en: As Hunter's Strike Z, except the critical is of equal severity.

sp-03891.description_en: All of the caster's chosen creatures who are within the area must make a RR, or suffer an 'B' Holy Spell critical.

sp-03892.description_en: As Block Summons Z, except it will work on creatures that are twelfth level or less.

sp-03894.description_en: magically dispel any magical gate, teleportal, or other magical portal. The gate will stay open if it makes a RR versus the caster (gates save as the level of the caster who opened them).

sp-03895.description_en: As Hunter's Strike Z, except the critical is one level greater in severity, with a maximum of an 'E' critical.

sp-03896.description_en: As Block Summons Z, except it will work on creatures that are fourteenth level or less.

sp-03897.description_en: Break Control ZZ, except it will affect the target's control over three creatures.

sp-03898.description_en: Caster sets up a magical field around the target gate, or magical portal. Beings attempting to pass through the gate must make a RR versus the level of the caster with a special -30 modifier. Failure indicates the being takes an 'E' Impact critical and does not pass through the gate.

sp-03899.description_en: IV -As Block Summons Z, except it will work on creatures that are sixteenth level or less.

sp-03900.description_en: As Hunter's Aura, except for the effect is a 'D' Holy Spell critical.

sp-03901.description_en: As Close Cute, except for range, and it will close all gates within the area.

sp-03902.description_en: As Break Control ZZ, except it will affect all the target's controlled creatures.

sp-03903.description_en: For the duration, caster will inflict Slaying criticals to his chosen creatures in addition to any normal criticals.

sp-03904.description_en: This only affects spells with a timed duration (not spells with a duration of P, C, or instant).

sp-03912.description_en: As Slow I, except it lasts two rounds.

sp-03914.description_en: As Quickness Z, except the bonus is 2dlO. Cl 50) Time Walk caster 1 min/lvl self U

sp-03915.description_en: As Slow I, except it lasts three rounds.

sp-03916.description_en: Predicts the most probable actions of a being in the next round. The target's specific action and targets are 25. Foreknowledge - Caster gains momentary insights into the learned (e.g., attack whom with what weapon in melee, cast a future. The caster gains a special bonus of +20 to DB on all attacks specific spell at a specific target, etc.). This results in the caster against him for the duration. It also grants him a special bonus being able to declare his actions for that round after hearing what of +10 to his OB to all attacks for the duration. the target has decided to do. Note that the target is free to change

sp-03924.description_en: except caster can predict his declared action with the requisite penalties. actions of all beings within 100' of him.

sp-03926.description_en: Allows caster to understand and “speak” the language of any one tree species.

sp-03927.description_en: Allows the caster to appear as any one type of tree. Caster retains his size and will not smell or feel like the tree (i.e. it is purely a visual illusion and is subject to normal illusion rules; see Spell Low Section 15.14 for more on illusions).

sp-03928.description_en: Heals 3dlO hits of damage on a tree.

sp-03929.description_en: Summons a wall of very tough (but pliable) thorns. The wall is up to 1O'xIO'x5'. All movement through the wall is reduced by 50%. All attacks through the wall suffer a -50 penalty. Anyone moving through it receives a takes a 'B' Puncture critical (no RR).

sp-03930.description_en: For the duration, caster's skin is treated as AT 3.

sp-03931.description_en: All non-magical fire in the area of effect is put out. Magical fire must make an RR or be extinguished.

sp-03932.description_en: Caster magically enters a tree and can leave from any other tree within range.

sp-03933.description_en: Creates a wall of tough branches that is IO' x 10' x 1'. All movement through the wall is reduced by 80%. All attacks through the wall suffer a -80 penalty. Anyone passing through it takes a '13' Puncture critical (no RR).

sp-03937.description_en: a wall of trees in the area of effect. The trees can be burned through or chopped down. They are rooted to the ground. The actual height of the trees will vary according to the trees in the area.

sp-03938.description_en: Target is rooted to the ground. He may make a Very Hard maneuver to break free. While rooted, all Unbalancing criticals are lowered by two degrees (i.e., a 'c' critical would become an 'A' critical, a 'B' critical would become an 'A' critical with a special modification of -25, an 'A' critical would become an 'A' critical with a special modification of -50).

sp-03939.description_en: For the duration, caster's skin is treated as AT 11.

sp-03940.description_en: Caster may animate a tree and control its actions by concentrating. (Tree will perform similarly to a Slowroot.)

sp-03941.description_en: As Smother, except for the area of effect and range, and magical fires suffer -20 to their RRs.

sp-03943.description_en: For the duration, caster's skin is treated as AT 20.

sp-03944.description_en: Caster can revive any one dead tree.

sp-03945.description_en: Caster may animate a tree and control its actions by concentrating. (Tree will perform similarly to a Treeherd.)

sp-03946.description_en: Caster can take the form, physical size, and abilities of any one tree with which he is familiar (GM's discretion.)

sp-03948.description_en: Caster can either issue a summons to every sentient tree within a forest, or animate one tree per level and bring them all to fight for a cause that is crucial to the forest's survival. (Trees are animated as in Command Tree, GM's discretion).

sp-05642.description_en: Caster can see through 10' per level of water (even murky water) as if it were day. Some residual light must exist for this spell to work.

sp-05643.description_en: As Watersight, except caster can see in normal darkness such as a clear night outdoors. Some residual light (e.g., starlight, phosphorescent fungus) must exist for this spell to work.

sp-05644.description_en: As Watersight, except caster can see in fog, mist, any other precipitation or any gas.

sp-05645.description_en: Caster can see through non-magical wood (up to 1" thickness per level of experience).

sp-05646.description_en: Caster's point of hearing may be moved independently away (up to 10' per level of experience) at a rate of 10' per round. He must physically be able to go there (e.g., he could not send his hearing through walls or closed doors).

sp-05647.description_en: Caster can pick a point (up to 10' away), and he will be able to see and/or hear from that point. The point is fixed but can be rotated. There can be intervening barriers such as walls.

sp-05648.description_en: Caster's point of sight may be moved independently away (up to 10' per level of experience) at a rate of 10' per round. The point of sight may also be rotated. He must physically be able to go there (e.g., he could not send his sight through walls or closed doors).

sp-05649.description_en: Caster can see all invisible beings or objects as if they were not invisible. Note that this means the invisible object is not “detected;” it simply isn't invisible to the caster.

sp-05650.description_en: As Woodsight II, except caster can see through any non-magical stone.

sp-05651.description_en: As Woodsight II, except caster can see through any non-magical iron or steel.

sp-05652.description_en: Caster can see “through” all visual illusions, phantasms, and glamours.

sp-05653.description_en: As Observe I, except for the range.

sp-05654.description_en: As Long Ear, except for the range and the caster may move any and all senses.

sp-05655.description_en: As Ironsight II, except caster may see through any non-magical metal.

sp-05656.description_en: As Nightsight, except caster can see through magically created darkness (such as those resulting from Dark or Utterdark spells) or total ordinary darkness (i.e., no residual light required).

sp-05657.description_en: As Observe I, except 2 points up to 100' away may be observed simultaneously.

sp-05658.description_en: As Observe I, except for the range.

sp-05659.description_en: As Woodsight, except caster can see through any non-magical wall of any thickness.

sp-05660.description_en: As Observe III, except caster does not have to concentrate until the spell is triggered by some movement or some sound which could be perceived from the observation point (and after the spell “activates,” the caster must concentrate on the point or the spell will be dispelled). If the caster is ever more than 100' per level of experience of the point selected, the spell is dispelled.

sp-05661.description_en: As Long Sense, except for the range.

sp-05662.description_en: As Observe III, except for the duration and the caster need not concentrate (he need only glance and listen once every three rounds).

sp-05663.description_en: As Woodsight II, except the caster can see through all inanimate material. Highly magical materials might receive an RR (at the GM's discretion).

sp-05664.description_en: As Long Sense, except the caster may move his senses with no limitations on range.

sp-05666.description_en: Caster can detect whether an unfulfilled fate, destiny, or wyrd lies upon a person, object, or place.

sp-05671.description_en: Predicts most probable action of a being in the next round; specifics are not learned (e.g., attack in melee, cast a spell; but no details on targets or exactly what spell) This results in the caster being able to declare his statement of intent for the round after hearing what the target has decided to do. Note the target is free to change his declared action (with the requisite penalties).

sp-05676.description_en: As Divinations I, except the prediction may concern events up to 1 month per level of the caster into the future.

sp-05678.description_en: This provides an analysis of an unfulfilled destiny in terms of who made the prophecy and/or the source of the destiny, the strength of the destiny, and where appropriate the oracular riddle (or whatever) which encapsulates the destiny. The spell does not indicate how a destiny may be fulfilled. Note that this spell will reveal if a given prophecy or divination is a hoax—the strength of the destiny will in such cases depend on the degree to which the victim of the hoax believes in the divination.

sp-05680.description_en: As Dream I, except limit is 3 dreams per night on different topics.

sp-05681.description_en: As Divinations III, except the predictions may concern events up to 1 year per level of the caster into the future.

sp-05682.description_en: As Anticipations III, except if any of the actions involve spell casting, the spells to be cast and the targets are learned.

sp-05683.description_en: As Anticipations V, except caster can either predict the most probable actions of 5 beings in the next round or can predict the most probable actions of one being over the next five rounds.

sp-05689.description_en: Caster stores the mental pattern of a target which must first have been detected by Presence. This pattern can be used with other spells on this list (and other lists). The caster can only have as many patterns stored as the sum of his Memory and Presence stats (not the bonuses). The caster can choose to release a pattern at any given time (the GM should require that a character keep track of all the patterns he has stored).

sp-05691.description_en: Caster learns direction and distance to any unshielded mind for which he has a mental pattern from Mind Store or Long Mind Store, and which is within range of this spell.

sp-05696.description_en: The caster knows when anyone within the radius is lying.

sp-05699.description_en: As Mind Store, except for the range.

sp-05703.description_en: As Truth I, except for the area of effect.

sp-05704.description_en: As Truth I, except for the range.

sp-05705.description_en: As Truth I, except when this spell is cast before any Vision Behind spell, it will detect anyone who is lying within the vision.

sp-05706.description_en: As Minor Finding, except for the range.

sp-05718.description_en: When cast before a Vision Behind spell, this allows the caster to perceive the past using one (and only one) additional sense (i.e., smell, taste, feel) or to use one and only one perceptive skill (in addition to the normal vision and hearing; such as Power Perception or Reality Awareness).

sp-05722.description_en: As Item Vision, except gives a vision of a significant event in the past which occurred at the caster's current location.

sp-05726.description_en: Gives a complete rundown on an item's construction, powers and purpose (completeness or specificity of information may be reduced if the item is extremely powerful).

sp-05727.description_en: As Vision Behind I, except time range is up to 1 year per level of the caster (with an accuracy of ±1 week) and the trance can last up to 5 hours per level of the caster.

sp-05728.description_en: As Item Vision, except gives a vision of a significant event which happened in the target's past.

sp-05729.description_en: By using an appropriate reflecting medium (e.g., a pool, crystal ball, or mirror), the caster may cast this spell before casting a Vision Behind spell to cause the vision to appear in the medium. Persons other than the caster will only receive the visual aspects of the vision. Each person other than the caster will continue to share the vision until either they stop concentrating, the caster stops concentrating, or the trance ends.

sp-05734.description_en: Caster may borrow the visual sense of any non-intelligent animal within range, thus sharing the visual perceptions of the animal. The animal must be within sight or located with a Presence spell or with Mind Store followed by Finding (for the initial contact only).

sp-05735.description_en: As Animal Sight I, except auditory sense is borrowed.

sp-05736.description_en: As Animal Sight I, except any and all senses may be borrowed.

sp-05737.description_en: As Animal Sight I, except any being's visual sense may be borrowed.

sp-05738.description_en: As Animal Hearing I, except any being's auditory sense may be borrowed.

sp-05739.description_en: As Animal Sight I, except for the range.

sp-05740.description_en: The caster may view a person, item, or location, seeing what is happening at that very moment at the “scried” site. The caster must be able to name the person or location uniquely (or describe the location, person, or item uniquely). The caster must concentrate upon some medium. The scried target will appear in the medium. If the medium is mobile (e.g., a crystal ball, a mirror), the range to the scried target is limited to 100' per level of the caster. If the medium is immobile (e.g., a pool), the range is limited to 1000' per level of the caster. The caster may only see what is happening at the scried site (no other senses are given) and may only use his normal visual faculties (no enhancements such as Nightsight or Woodsight are permitted). Unless the spell Scrying Share is used, only the caster will be able to see the vision in the medium (others who can see the medium will see nothing) Persons at a scried site may make a Power Perception maneuver (with a Hard difficulty) to notice that they are being scried (though only educated persons will know the cause of this feeling).

sp-05741.description_en: As Animal Sense I, except for the range.

sp-05743.description_en: As Sight Merge I, except for the range.

sp-05744.description_en: As Animal Sight I, except for the range.

sp-05745.description_en: As Animal Sense I, except any and all senses may be borrowed from any being.

sp-05746.description_en: As Animal Sense I, except for the range.

sp-05747.description_en: As Scrying I, except the range limitation is 1 mile per level of the caster for a mobile medium and 10 miles per level for an immobile medium.

sp-05748.description_en: As Sight Merge I, except for the range.

sp-05749.description_en: As Animal Sight I, except for the range.

sp-05750.description_en: By casting this on targets (up to a maximum of 1 target per level of the caster) prior to casting a Scrying spell, the targets will be able to see what the scryer sees while the Scrying spell is active (and the target(s) remain concentrating). The same caveats that apply to the scryer apply to all who share the scrying. Note that the size of the medium may practically limit the number of targets that can view the medium while the spell is active.

sp-05751.description_en: As Sensory Merge I, except for the range.

sp-05752.description_en: As Animal Sense I, except for the range.

sp-05753.description_en: As Sight Merge I, except for the range.

sp-05754.description_en: As Sensory Merge, except for the range.

sp-05755.description_en: As Scrying I, except range is limited to 10 miles per level of the caster for a mobile medium and 100 miles per level of the caster for an immobile medium.

sp-05756.description_en: As Sensory Merge, except for the range.

sp-05757.description_en: Detects if a being, item, or place in the area of effect is currently being scried upon. The caster may concentrate on a different 5'R each round.

sp-05758.description_en: Detects if an attempt is being made to divine the future of a being, item, or place in the area of effect. The caster may concentrate on a different 5'R each round.

sp-05759.description_en: Allows the caster to cloud the scrying of a specific subject touched by the caster at the time of casting this spell. If this spell is successful, the scryer perceives his vision as if through a fog, gaining only 50% of the knowledge that he would have gained if unimpeded. This protection lasts until the duration runs out, the spell is cancelled (or dispelled), or the defense is pierced by a scryer (whichever happens first).

sp-05760.description_en: Allows the caster to conceal one curse or destiny which lies upon the subject, rendering the curse or destiny undetectable by Detect Curse or Detect Destiny. The curse or destiny is still fully active, merely hidden to magical detections.

sp-05761.description_en: Allows the caster to protect the chosen subject (touched at time of casting), by if successful causing the scrying to go awry and lock onto a very similar subject (the similar subject must be within 10' per level of the caster at the time of the casting of this spell). The decoy subject will appear so similar that the scryer must make a successful Altertness maneuver to realize his mistake. If no suitable decoy exists, this spell will fail.

sp-05762.description_en: All deeds performed by the target (while this spell is active) are “shadowed” to appropriate spells. For the purposes of appropriate spells (e.g., Death's Memory or Vision Behind), the information gained about the target will be shrouded in shadows.

sp-05763.description_en: For the duration of this spell, if the target successfully resists any “information-gathering” or “mind-reading” spells, he may portray falsehoods as truths. If the caster of the mindreading spell is aware by other means that the target must be deceiving him, or if the False Truth spell duration ends before the mind-reading spell's duration, the deception will be apparent.

sp-05764.description_en: This spell enables the target to mislead the caster of any Anticipate or Anticipations spell. In the case of Anticipations spells, the caster receives incorrect information with regard to the target's intended actions. In the case of Anticipate Blow, Anticipate Missile, Anticipate Spell, and Anticipate Attack, the caster of these spells receives no benefit from casting these spells (though the spells will be cast successfully, the benefit is negated by negative penalties applied to the positive bonuses).

sp-05765.description_en: The caster may set a false vision upon the chosen subject for “would-be” scryers to discover. The false vision must be fairly simple and may not portray scenes or events longer than the duration of this spell. This spell can be defeated by piercing or by repeated scrying (i.e., out-lasting the duration of this spell), or noting that something unlikely is occurring, or noting that events in the scrying repeat themselves exactly.

sp-05766.description_en: As Cloud Scrying, except the caster can cloud any form of divinatory magic upon the subject.

sp-05767.description_en: Once learned, this spell allows the caster to know when any scrying attempt is made upon him.

sp-05768.description_en: As Feel Scrying, except allows the caster to know when an attempt to divine information about him is made.

sp-05769.description_en: As Shadow Past, except absolutely no information about the target will be revealed. For example, a Death's Memory cast on the scene of a murder might show the victim collapsing with a knife in his chest (but no sign of the knifewielder). The shrouding may be pierced, otherwise it is permanent.

sp-05770.description_en: Any attempt to divine information about the protected subject (touched at time of casting) will receive a false reading, with the elements of the reading specified by the caster at time of casting.

sp-05771.description_en: The target of this spell appears to have no presence for the duration of this spell, and so may not be detected by Presence-type spells.

sp-05772.description_en: The caster may use this spell to determine the location and identity of a scryer whose activities have been detected by either Detect Scrying, Feel Scrying, or Power Perception.

sp-05773.description_en: As Scrying Analysis, except determines the location and identity of a diviner whose activities have been detected by either Detect Divinations, Feel Divinations, or Power Perception.

sp-05774.description_en: As Shadow Past, except all deeds performed by the target (while this spell is active) will appear as if someone else is performing them. The false actor is chosen by the caster at the time of casting and the effectiveness of the falsification will depend on how well the caster can visualize the intended “fall guy.” Merely observing someone is not as good as any of the following spells: Study Pasty, Impersonation Study, or Change Lore.

sp-05775.description_en: The caster may use this spell to conceal the memories of the target from Inner Thoughts, Mind Scan, and Mind Probe spells etc. The caster may hide memories at a rate of one scene per round (with a maximum number of rounds equal to the caster's level). The hidden memories are still available to the target.

sp-05776.description_en: As Conceal Memories, except the caster may replace real memories with false memories at a rate of one memory per round. The target has access to both the true and the false memories.

sp-05777.description_en: The subject of this spell is protected from all divinatory magic for the duration of the spell. This spell lasts until it is cancelled, dispelled, or the duration runs out (whichever is sooner), and may not be pierced. Any divinatory magic attempted upon the subject will simply fail, and any divinatory magic attempted upon other subjects where the protected subject may directly or indirectly significantly effect the future of the protected subject will provide answers which do not take the possible actions of the protected subject into account. However the protected subject may not use divinatory magic of any sort upon himself or other subjects for the duration of this spell. The subject is truly outside the weave of fate.

sp-05780.description_en: As Star Voice, except the caster may mentally speak with any one thinking being that he can see.

sp-05784.description_en: As Prepare Voice I, except the range is increased by 20 times.

sp-05786.description_en: Caster can cause his voice to be heard at a point up to 100' away (in amplified tones). If the location is out of sight, the caster must have been there.

sp-05788.description_en: As Prepare Voice I, except the range is increased by 50 times.

sp-05790.description_en: As Long Voice I, except the point can be up to 300' away.

sp-05793.description_en: As Prepare Voice I, except the range is increased by 100 times.

sp-05794.description_en: As Long Voice I, except the point can be up to 500' away.

sp-05795.description_en: As Greater Mind Voice I, except the range is 5 miles.

sp-05796.description_en: As Prepare Voice I, except range is increased by 500 times.

sp-05807.description_en: This spell gives the caster the ability to scan the past by “feeling the temporal location for significant events.” This translates to the caster knowing the approximate time-frames of significant events, without knowing the nature of the events. To use this knowledge, the caster must cast a Vision Behind spell (within one minute of casting this spell).

sp-05808.description_en: As Literacy I, except the caster has the reading level of the average literate man, and may write at a “ninth grade level” (equivalent to someone who has completed “secondary” education or finished a craft or trade apprenticeship). For the duration of the spell, the caster has the equivalent of skill rank 6 in the written form of the language.

sp-05811.description_en: As Vision Behind I, except time range is up to 10 minutes per level of the caster (with an accuracy of ±5 minutes) and the trance can last up to 1 minute per level of the caster.

sp-05813.description_en: As Vision Behind I, except time range is up to 1 hour per level of the caster (with an accuracy of ±30 minutes) and the trance can last up to 5 minutes per level of the caster.

sp-05814.description_en: As Dream I, except limit is 4 dreams per night on different topics.

sp-05816.description_en: As Vision Behind I, except time range is up to 1 day per level of the caster (with an accuracy of ±1 hour) and the trance can last up to 10 minutes per level of the caster.

sp-05817.description_en: As Vision Behind I, except time range is up to 1 month per level of the caster (with an accuracy of ±1 day) and the trance can last up to 1 hour per level of the caster.

sp-05827.description_en: As Self Aura I, except subtracts 10 from all attacks.

sp-05828.description_en: A 6" radius ball of light is shot from the palm of the caster. It will travel to the limit of the range, explode (as a flare), burn with a bright light (as a flare), drift slowly to earth, and go out. An area of radius equal to the range is lit if the flare can rise to its full range. The flare drops at 10' per round. If fired at a target, resolve the attack as a Shock Bolt that delivers Heat criticals.

sp-05830.description_en: As Self Aura I, except subtracts 15 from all attacks.

sp-05833.description_en: A bolt of intense coherent light (color chosen by the caster at time of casting, but may not be white) is shot from the caster's palm. The attack is resolved on the Fire Bolt Attack Table, with the following special rules: If the bolt hits a reflective surface (such as a mirror or a highly polished breastplate), the bolt will be harmlessly scattered; however the reflective surface will be burned/tarnished (losing its reflectivity until repaired or polished). If the bolt hits a surface which has the same color as the bolt (a green bolt strikes the target's green robes), the concussion hit damage delivered by the bolt is halved (round down; e.g., a result of 5 hits and an 'A' critical becomes 2 hits and an 'A' critical).

sp-05834.description_en: As Light II, except the caster can delay the effects of the spell and it can be triggered by one of the following (decided by caster at time of casting): elapsed time (up to 24 hours), specific movements, specific sounds, or touch.

sp-05837.description_en: As Beacon V, except the ray can be up to 10 miles long.

sp-05838.description_en: As Light II, except up to 20 areas can be lit with a total radius of 200'.

sp-05839.description_en: As Utterlight I, except up to 5 areas can be lit with a total radius of 50'.

sp-05840.description_en: As Lesser Starbolt, except the range is 1,000'.

sp-05845.description_en: Determines the Ascendant and Midheaven for a given time at a given location to an accuracy of one angular minute (one-sixtieth of a degree), and determines the Sun Sign for that given time.

sp-05846.description_en: Determines the astrological positions of all culturally relevant celestial bodies for a given location on a given day up to one year into the past or up to one year into the future.

sp-05847.description_en: Given a birth chart, the caster can correlate all the astrologically significant information to provide one of three types of interpretation of the celestial influences on the person described by that birth chart. The caster can provide a general character analysis of the person in terms of all areas of life, a detailed analysis of the person for one specific area of life (e.g., health, love, aspirations etc.), or a problem analysis considering the merits and demerits of that person with respect to some decision or undertaking. The duration of this spell represents the necessary time for the caster's mind to organize a description of the interpretation.

sp-05848.description_en: Given a query concerning a decision, an action, an event, etc., the caster can provide an assessment of the outcome of querent's topic based upon the celestial influences beginning from the time at which the query was asked until ten minutes per level of the caster into the future. The caster's prediction will depend on the nature of the query, but might include whether the outcome will be positive or negative, the probable outcome, any “trends” which will probably develop in the time-frame. With longer timeframes, the predictions will fail to note the lesser trends or minor events. Only one Horary spell may be cast by the caster in any given 24-hour period, and failed spells count towards that limit. The prediction will be accurate 25% of the time plus 1% per level of the caster (otherwise, the results will be random). The duration of this spell is the time required to assess the celestial influences.

sp-05849.description_en: As Ephemeris I, except can be up to three years into the past or the future.

sp-05850.description_en: Caster can determine the exact location of the target's birth to the nearest mile.

sp-05851.description_en: Caster can determine the date of birth and time of birth of the target to the nearest minute.

sp-05852.description_en: As Horary I, except the time frame which can be assessed is 1 hour per level of the caster into the future.

sp-05853.description_en: As Ephemeris I, except can be up to five years into the past or the future.

sp-05854.description_en: Given a birth chart which has been progressed for a single month in a given year (either in the past or in the future), the caster can correlate all the astrologically significant information to provide an interpretation of the celestial influences upon the person described by the chart over the course of that month. The caster can provide a general summary of the trends in one specific area of life over the course of that month. The interpretation will not reveal the destination(s) involved nor the timings of the journeys. The duration of this spell represents the necessary time for the caster's mind to organize a description of the interpretation.

sp-05855.description_en: Allows the caster to determine all the aspects in a given chart or charts which are considered relevant in the caster's system of astrology. This will usually include all conjunctions, oppositions, squares, trines, quincunx, sextiles, etc.

sp-05856.description_en: As Horary I, except the time frame which can be assessed is 1 day per level of the caster into the future.

sp-05857.description_en: As Ephemeris I, except can be up to ten years into the past or the future.

sp-05858.description_en: Based on available previously determined data (e.g., Ascendant, Midheaven, celestial positions), the caster can trace out an astrological chart (which is completely accurate given the available information) onto a suitable surface. The duration of this spell represents the time taken for the caster to trace out the chart.

sp-05859.description_en: As Interpret Progression I, except the caster can either choose to have a general summary of the trends in all areas of life in the month of interest or can choose to have a detailed analysis of one specific area of life (e.g., travel). In the latter case, the interpretation will reveal events and trends of lesser importance and may disclose the timings of these events to the nearest day.

sp-05860.description_en: As Horary I, except the time frame which can be assessed is 1 week per level of the caster into the future.

sp-05861.description_en: As Ephemeris XV, except can be up to fifteen years into the past or the future.

sp-05862.description_en: Given a number of birth charts or progressed birth charts, the caster can correlate the astrologically significant information in terms of correspondences between or among the birth charts. The caster can then provide an analysis of how the persons described by the given charts will interact with each other based on the celestial influences exerted upon them either at their births or at a given time. A synastric interpretation might (in many cultures) be required to determine if a given marriage was astrologically advisable or to determine the soundness of a business partnership. The caster can only provide a synastric interpretation for a maximum of one chart per five levels of the caster (round up). The duration of this spell represents the necessary time for the caster's mind to organize a description of the interpretation.

sp-05863.description_en: As Ephemeris I, except can be up to twenty years into the past or the future.

sp-05864.description_en: As Horary I, except the time frame which can be assessed is 1 month per level of the caster into the future.

sp-05865.description_en: As Ephemeris I, except can be up to two years per level of the caster into the past or the future.

sp-05866.description_en: As Horary I, except the time frame which can be assessed is 1 year per level of the caster into the future.

sp-05867.description_en: As Ephemeris I, except can be up to five years per level of the caster into the past or the future.

sp-05869.description_en: Gives the direction and distance to any specific object or place that the caster is familiar with or has had described in detail. The object or place must be within 100' of the caster.

sp-05871.description_en: As Location I, except the range is 300'.

sp-05874.description_en: As Location I, except the range is 500'.

sp-05875.description_en: Caster learns the race, profession, and level of a target. The target must have been located by the Presence spell.

sp-05878.description_en: The caster can transfer a copy of any one Mind Stored pattern to another spell user from the Mentalism realm (i.e., both casters now have the person stored). The target of this spell must know the Mind Store spell (but he needn't spend the PPs to cast Mind Store).

sp-05879.description_en: As Presence, but the caster also gains general knowledge of the targets' actions. In a tactical situation, the caster can declare his actions after learning one of the targets' actions for the round (and in which “phase” they want to perform the action). This does not prevent the targets from changing their actions (with the appropriate penalty for changing their actions).

sp-05881.description_en: As Location I, except for the range.

sp-05883.description_en: As Minor Finding, except for the range.

sp-05884.description_en: As Stareyes, except the caster can see in magically created darkness as if it were day.

sp-05885.description_en: As Direction, except for the range.

sp-05886.description_en: As Starhearing, except the caster is able to attune himself to the “music of the spheres” on dark nights when there is neither starlight nor moonlight.

sp-05893.description_en: The target must answer a single-concept question truthfully (though he must be able to understand the question).

sp-05894.description_en: As Voice of Calming, except the target will become afraid of one person (including the caster), object, or place chosen by the caster at time of casting, and will flee in fear from the source of that fear at maximum pace for the duration of this spell. Note that unless the target is restrained (even in a minor way), he will attempt to run after one round.

sp-05896.description_en: For the duration of this spell, the caster receives a special +10 bonus to all non-magical attempts to persuade and/or influence people.

sp-05902.description_en: As Orate I, except the bonus is +20.

sp-05903.description_en: As Speech I, except the caster speaks the target language as if he were a native. For the duration of the spell, the caster has the equivalent of skill rank 8 (spoken) in the language.

sp-05906.description_en: As Voice of Command, except effects all within range who can hear and understand the caster.

sp-05907.description_en: As Speech I, except the caster has absolute fluency in the target language and all closely related dialects. For the duration of the spell, the caster has the equivalent of skill rank 10 (spoken) in the language.

sp-05908.description_en: As Voice of Beguilement, except effects all within range who can hear and understand the caster.

sp-05913.description_en: [RR Mod = -50] Target makes an RR. Failure results in one being ,chosen by the caster, becoming invisible to the target; others see the protected being normally. If the protected being makes an obvious action (e.g., talking, moving an object, etc.), the target may attempt another RR (the GM may deem it appropriate to apply modifiers to this RR based upon the action the protected being takes). If the protected being attacks the target, he may make another RR with a +50 modifier.

sp-05914.description_en: [RR Mod = -50] Target makes an RR. Failure results in one being, chosen by the caster, becoming inaudible to the target; others hear the protected being normally. If the protected being causes a sound arising from 1' beyond his body, the target may attempt another RR (the GM may deem it appropriate to apply modifiers to this RR based upon the action the protected being takes). If the protected being attacks the target (e.g., casting a spell with a verbal component), he may make another RR with a +50 modifier.

sp-05915.description_en: [RR Mod = -50] Target makes an RR. Failure results in one being, chosen by the caster, becoming invisible and inaudible to the target, as per Cloak Sight and Cloak Hearing.

sp-05916.description_en: [RR Mod = -50] Target makes an RR. Failure results in the target becoming unable to feel, taste, or smell one being, chosen by the caster; others sense the protected being normally. If the protected being attacks the target (e.g., by physically striking the target with a fist), he may make another RR with a +50 modifier. Note that if the target is attacked by the protected being, he will not know it (as he cannot feel the attack); he will still suffer the damage, but won't know why (though he will get another RR).

sp-05917.description_en: As Minor Cloak I and Cloak Feel/Taste/ Smell, except the target cannot see, hear, smell, taste or feel the being chosen by the caster.

sp-05918.description_en: As Minor Cloak I, except affects three targets. The caster makes one BAR that applies to all of the targets.

sp-05919.description_en: [RR Mod = -50] Target makes an RR. Failure results in the target becoming unable to detect the mental pattern of one being chosen by the caster through magical means (or special sense); others may perceive the protected being normally.

sp-05920.description_en: [RR Mod = -50] Target makes an RR. Failure results in the target becoming unable to detect one being, chosen by the caster, using unusual senses; others perceive the protected being normally. Examples of unusual senses might include sonar, magnetic senses, the life detection ability of undead etc.

sp-05921.description_en: As Lesser Cloak I, except affects 3 targets. The caster makes one BAR that applies to all of the targets.

sp-05922.description_en: As Lesser Cloak I, except the target cannot perceive the being, chosen by the caster, using any senses possessed by the target.

sp-05923.description_en: As Minor Cloak I, except affects 5 targets.

sp-05924.description_en: As Minor Cloak I, except affects all targets within a chosen 10'R. The caster makes one BAR which is applied to all of the targets.

sp-05925.description_en: As Lesser Cloak I, except affects 5 targets.

sp-05926.description_en: As Greater Cloak I, except affects three targets. The caster makes one BAR which is applied to all the targets.

sp-05927.description_en: As either Sphere of Cloaking I except affects all targets within a chosen 30'R or as Lesser Cloak I, except affects all targets within a chosen 10'R. In either case, the caster makes one BAR which is applied to all of the targets.

sp-05928.description_en: As Minor Cloak I, except affects 10 targets.

sp-05929.description_en: As Lesser Cloak I, except affects 10 targets.

sp-05930.description_en: As Greater Cloak I, except affects 5 targets.

sp-05931.description_en: As either Sphere of Cloaking I, except affects all targets within a chosen 50'R or as Lesser Cloak I, except affects all targets within a chosen 30'R, or as Greater Cloak I, except affects all targets within a chosen 10'R. In any case, the caster makes one BAR which is applied to all of the targets.

sp-05932.description_en: As Minor Cloak I, except affects one target per level of the caster and the range is only limited to the caster's field of vision.

sp-05933.description_en: As Lesser Cloak I, except affects one target per level of the caster and the range is only limited to the caster's field of vision.

sp-05934.description_en: As Greater Cloak I, except affects ten targets.

sp-05935.description_en: As Greater Cloak I, except affects one target per level of the caster and the range is only limited to the caster's field of vision.

sp-05936.description_en: The caster can create a visual (static or dynamic) image which is perceived in the mind of one target for the duration of this spell. The caster can set up to one conditional action per level of the caster in the Seeming spell (this action requires no concentration by the caster). This action can be triggered on a given action by the target. The caster can concentrate and exercise dynamic control over what is perceived in the target's mind (thought the target must still be within range of the caster for this to work).

sp-05937.description_en: As Light Seeming, except the caster can create a set of sounds.

sp-05938.description_en: Caster can determine if the target is being affected by an Overlay or Seeming spell.

sp-05939.description_en: As Light Seeming, except the caster can create a set of smells.

sp-05940.description_en: This spell will allow the next Overlay or Seeming spell from either this list or Seeming Law to be able to affect animal targets (though the spell must be cast within one minute of completing this spell).

sp-05941.description_en: As Light Seeming, except the caster can create a set of tastes.

sp-05942.description_en: The caster can attempt to stop an Overlay or Seeming from effecting a given being (note that the Overlay or Seeming must already be “detected” with a Detect Seeming spell). The Overlay or Seeming spell is allowed a RR (at the level of its caster or the spell level if the former is unknown); if the RR is successful, it continues to affect the being. If the RR is failed, the spell will no longer effect this being, other targets will continue to be effected.

sp-05943.description_en: As Light Seeming, except the caster can create a set of tactile sensations.

sp-05944.description_en: The caster can analyze a detected Overlay or Seeming spell to determine the nature of the spell in terms of the hallucination it is generating within the mind of the affected being. The analyzed spell is allowed a RR (at the level of its caster or the spell level if the former is unknown); if the RR is successful, no information is gained.

sp-05945.description_en: This spell will allow the caster to create up to two simultaneous streams of perceptual input when concentrating on the next Overlay or Seeming spell from either this list or Seeming Law. When providing two streams, the activity for concentrating on the enhanced spell is raised to 75%. Note that the Overlay or Seeming spell must be cast within one minute of completing this spell.

sp-05946.description_en: As Light Seeming, except the caster can create a mental pattern which can be detected by and interact with appropriate spells or special senses.

sp-05947.description_en: This spell will allow the caster to extend the range over which he can dynamically concentrate upon the next Overlay or Seeming spell. Such a spell will have a range of 100' per level of the caster. Note that the next Overlay or Seeming spell must be cast within one minute of completing this spell.

sp-05948.description_en: As Animal Seeming, except it will enable the enhanced Overlay or Seeming spell to effect sentient plants.

sp-05949.description_en: As Light Seeming, except the caster can create a set of sensations appropriate to a given esoteric sense. Examples of unusual senses would include sonar, magnetic senses, the life detection ability of undead etc.

sp-05950.description_en: As Animal Seeming, except it will enable the enhanced Overlay or Seeming spell to affect Elementals, Constructs, Golems, Spirits, Undead, and other supernatural beings with at least minimal intelligence.

sp-05951.description_en: As Far Seeming I, except the range for concentration is increased to 1,000 feet per level of the caster.

sp-05952.description_en: As Dual Seeming, except the caster can supply up to three simultaneous distinct streams of perceptual input and the necessary level of concentration (for three streams) is increased to 90% activity.

sp-05953.description_en: As Far Seeming I, except the range for concentration is increased to one mile per level of the caster.

sp-05954.description_en: As Dual Seeming, except the caster can supply up to four simultaneous distinct streams of perceptual input and the necessary level of concentration (for four streams) is increased to 100% activity.

sp-05955.description_en: As Far Seeming I, except the range for concentration is ten miles per level of the caster.

sp-05956.description_en: The caster can alter the visual appearance of an item, being, or place as perceived in the mind of one target for the duration of this spell. The other characteristics of the item, being, or place do not change. The nature of the item, place, or being does not change (e.g., a book will remain a book, a bridge will remain a bridge, etc.). The caster can set up to one conditional action per level of the caster in the Overlay spell (this action requires no concentration from the caster). The action is triggered on a given action by the target with the item, being, or place that has been overlaid. By concentrating, the caster can exercise dynamic control over what is perceived in the target's mind with regard to the affected item, being, or place (though the target must still be within range of the caster). The caster may choose one of the following options: a) an extra sense can be added to the Overlay (the corresponding Seeming spell from the Seeming Enhancement spell list must be known), b) an additional target may be affected, c) the duration can be doubled, d) the range can be doubled, or e) an additional item, being, or place may be altered.

sp-05957.description_en: The caster can create a visual (static or dynamic) image (e.g., of an item, being, or place) which is perceived in the mind of one target for the duration of this spell. The caster can set up to one conditional action per level of the caster in the Seeming spell (this action requires no concentration from the caster). This action is triggered on a given action by the target. By concentrating, the caster can exercise dynamic control over what is perceived in the target's mind (though the target must still be within range of the caster). The caster may choose one of the following options: a) an extra sense can be added to the Seeming (the corresponding Seeming spell from Seeming Enhancement spell list must be known), b) an additional target may be affected, c) the duration can be doubled, d) the range can be doubled, or e) an additional image (of an item, being or place) can be created.

sp-05958.description_en: As Overlay II, except the caster may choose two of the options.

sp-05959.description_en: As Seeming II, except any two of the options may be chosen.

sp-05960.description_en: As Overlay II, except it can be delayed up to 24 hours. At the time of casting, the caster must decide upon the trigger for the spell. The caster can choose one of the following as a trigger for the spell: a) time period, b) specified movement, c) specified sound, d) specified touch, e) specified smell, f) specified taste, or g) other specified sensation perceived by the target.

sp-05961.description_en: As Seeming II, except it can be delayed up to 24 hours. At the time of casting, the caster must decide upon the trigger for the spell. The caster can choose one of the following as a trigger for the spell: a) time period, b) specified movement, c) specified sound, d) specified touch, e) specified smell, f) specified taste, or g) other specified sensation perceived by the target.

sp-05962.description_en: As Overlay III, except four of the options may be chosen.

sp-05963.description_en: As Seeming II, except four of the options may be chosen.

sp-05964.description_en: As Waiting Overlay I, except the caster may choose two of the options.

sp-05965.description_en: As Waiting Seeming II, except two of the options can be chosen.

sp-05966.description_en: As Overlay III, except nine of the options may be chosen.

sp-05967.description_en: As Seeming II, except nine of the options may be chosen.

sp-05968.description_en: As Waiting Overlay III, except four of the options may be chosen.

sp-05969.description_en: As Waiting Seeming II, except four of the options can be chosen.

sp-05970.description_en: As Overlay III, except fourteen of the options may be chosen.

sp-05971.description_en: As Seeming II, except fourteen of the options may be chosen.

sp-05972.description_en: As Waiting Overlay III, except nine of the options may be chosen.

sp-05973.description_en: As Waiting Seeming II, except nine of the options can be chosen.

sp-05974.description_en: As Overlay III, except nineteen of the options may be chosen.

sp-05975.description_en: As Seeming II, except nineteen of the options may be chosen.

sp-05976.description_en: As Waiting Overlay III, except nineteen of the options may be chosen.

sp-05977.description_en: As Waiting Seeming II, except nineteen of the options can be chosen.

sp-05978.description_en: As either Overlay III or Seeming II except option per level of the caster may be chosen.

sp-05979.description_en: Detects if a target is under the influence of a charm or other mind control affect (generally speaking, that would include any spell with a sub-type of “m”). The mind control spell may resist detection by making an RR at the level of the caster of the charm spell (or the level of the charm spell).

sp-05980.description_en: The target of this spell will take no offensive action, and will fight only in selfdefence.

sp-05981.description_en: Target will follow a single suggested act that is not completely alien to him (e.g., no suicide suggestions, no blinding himself suggestions, etc.).

sp-05982.description_en: Causes the target to be affected by any one desired emotion chosen at time of casting. Possible emotions include hate, love, sadness, anger, fear, etc. The caster may choose the object of the induced emotion.

sp-05983.description_en: Caster can cause the target to doubt the truth of one belief or fact chosen by the caster for the duration of this spell. The target may regain his belief prematurely if he is presented with irrefutable evidence of the doubted belief's truth or persuaded of its veracity.

sp-05984.description_en: The target must obey the caster for the duration of this spell, as specified in Suggestion I.

sp-05985.description_en: Caster can cause the target to believe, with complete certainty, an idea, reasoning, or “fact” implanted by the caster for the duration of this spell. The target may lose this belief prematurely if he is presented with irrefutable evidence of the falsehood of the belief or persuaded of its falsehood.

sp-05986.description_en: As Calm I, except affects 3 targets.

sp-05987.description_en: As Suggestion I, except affects 3 targets and the range is 20'.

sp-05988.description_en: As Emotion I, except affects 3 targets.

sp-05989.description_en: As Obedience I, except affects 2 targets.

sp-05990.description_en: As Calm I, except affects 5 targets.

sp-05991.description_en: As Suggestion I, except affects 5 targets and the range is 30'.

sp-05992.description_en: As Emotion I, except affects 5 targets.

sp-05993.description_en: As Obedience I, except affects 3 targets and the range is 20'.

sp-05994.description_en: As Calm I, except affects 10 targets.

sp-05995.description_en: As Suggestion I, except affects 5 targets and the range is 50'.

sp-05996.description_en: As Emotion I, except affects 10 targets.

sp-05997.description_en: As Obedience I, except affects 5 targets and the range is 30'.

sp-05998.description_en: As Calm I, except affects 1 target per level of the caster.

sp-05999.description_en: As Suggestion I, except affects 1 target per level of the caster and the range is 100'.

sp-06000.description_en: As Emotion I, except affects 1 target per level of the caster.

sp-06001.description_en: As Obedience I, except affects 1 target per level of the caster and the range is 100'.

sp-06002.description_en: The caster causes the target to relive an experience chosen by the caster at time of casting. If the target is in a relaxed state of mind, the target will be in a reverie and oblivious to his surroundings unless disturbed (loud noise, physical prod, etc.). If the target is active, the target will remain active but be distracted by momentary flashbacks and the attempts of his mind to relate the experience to the current situation (-20 to all actions). This spell will also provide the target with a +25 bonus to recalling specific details of the remembered experience. This bonus is not cumulative with Force Recall or Recall spells.

sp-06003.description_en: The caster can select a topic and obtain one cue per level of the caster from the target. Each cue will relate to an experience of the target with respect to the topic. These cues are used as the triggers for the Relive and Share Experience spells.

sp-06004.description_en: Caster can assess the target's ability (in terms of skill ranks) with regard to one specific skill or spell list chosen at time of casting.

sp-06005.description_en: As Relive Experience, except that a second target shares the remembering of the experience of the principal target. The caster must choose which target is to be the principal target at time of casting.

sp-06006.description_en: Allows the caster to improve the target's memory for the duration of this spell. The caster may choose to limit the topics on which the improvement will be obtained. Any maneuver involving Memory receives a special bonus of +10. This is not cumulative with Force Recall II, Recall or Relive Experience spells.

sp-06007.description_en: Caster can temporarily tap the language skills of the target, enabling the caster to use one language at the level of fluency (spoken and written) of the target. The language must be chosen at time of casting. For the duration of this spell, the caster must use the target's skill at the given language, even if the target is less fluent than the caster in the chosen language.

sp-06008.description_en: As Share Experience II, except three targets relive the chosen experience.

sp-06009.description_en: As Tap Skill I, except the caster can tap one purely mental skill of the target (that would be any skill that uses either Memory or Reasoning as one of it's stat bonuses). For the duration, the caster replaces his skill rank bonus with that of the target, and recalculates the skill bonus for the skill.

sp-06010.description_en: As Share Experience II, except five targets relive the chosen experience.

sp-06011.description_en: Caster receives surface thoughts from target, learns the reasoning and the thought patterns behind the surface thoughts, and may additionally scan the target's conscious memories, at a rate of one scene every round. If the target makes his RR by more than 25, he realizes that someone is trying to read his thoughts. The caster can concentrate on a new target each round.

sp-06012.description_en: As Tap Skill I, except the caster can tap one physical (any skill that uses either Strength, Agility, or Constitution as one of it's stat bonuses, except OB related skills) or mental skill of the target (as defined in Tap Skill II). For the duration, the caster replaces his skill rank bonus with that of the target, and recalculates the skill bonus for the skill.

sp-06013.description_en: The caster can remove one thought or memory from the target's mind each round.

sp-06014.description_en: As Tap Skill I, except the caster can tap one combat skill (OB related skill) of the target. For the duration, the caster replaces his skill rank bonus with that of the target, and recalculates the skill bonus for the skill.

sp-06015.description_en: Caster can copy one thought or memory from the target into his own mind each round.

sp-06016.description_en: Caster may use one spell list (chosen at time of casting) of the target accessing the spell knowledge up to 5th level or the number of skill ranks possessed by the target (whichever is lower). For the duration of this spell, the caster's knowledge of the spell list is limited to the knowledge possessed by the target. The caster must use his own PPs and must always make a Spell Casting Static Maneuver, with all appropriate penalties taken into consideration. Any failed spells suffer a special modification of +50 to all spell failure results (i.e., add +50 to all spell failure rolls).

sp-06017.description_en: As Force Recall I, except any maneuver Memory receives a special bonus of +25.

sp-06018.description_en: As Share Experience II, except ten targets relive the chosen experience.

sp-06019.description_en: As Mind Scan, except caster can probe target's subconscious memories (i.e., all experiences).

sp-06020.description_en: As Copy Experience, except the caster can copy one thought or memory from his mind into the mind of the target.

sp-06021.description_en: As Tap Spell V, except the caster can access the spell knowledge up to 10th level or the number of skill ranks possessed by the target (whichever is lower).

sp-06022.description_en: As Share Experience II, except one target per level of the caster relive the chosen experience. .

sp-06023.description_en: As Tap Spell V, except the caster can access the spell knowledge up to 20th level or the number of skill ranks possessed by the target (whichever is lower).

sp-06024.description_en: As Tap Spell V, except the caster can access the spell knowledge up to 50th level or the number of skill ranks possessed by the target (whichever is lower).

sp-06025.description_en: The target suffers a special penalty of -30 to all actions.

sp-06026.description_en: The target is rendered unable to speak for the duration of the spell.

sp-06027.description_en: The target will believe that he is afflicted with a wound of a type chosen by the caster (i.e., roll an 'A” severity critical on a chosen critical strike table). The target will perceive all the symptoms of the injury, but will not in reality suffer the effects. If as a result of the injury, the target falls “unconscious,” the target will pass out due to mental shock for one round per level of the caster. If as a result of the injury, the target would “die,” then the target will pass out from mental shock for one minute per level of the caster.

sp-06028.description_en: The target loses his sense of hearing for the duration of this spell.

sp-06029.description_en: A chosen limb of the target is numb and useless for the duration of this spell. If the limb is a leg, the target loses 40% of his movement. If the limb is an arm, the target suffers -40 to melee and missile fire using that arm.

sp-06030.description_en: As Wound A, except the apparent wound can be up to a 'B' severity critical.

sp-06031.description_en: For the duration of this spell, the target will believe that he is suffering from the effects of one non-life-threatening illness (chosen by the caster).

sp-06032.description_en: The target loses his sense of sight for the duration of this spell.

sp-06033.description_en: As Wound A, except the apparent wound can be up to a 'C' severity critical.

sp-06034.description_en: The target loses one sense (other than sight or hearing) chosen by the caster at time of casting.

sp-06036.description_en: As Wound A, except the apparent wound can be up to a 'D' severity critical.

sp-06037.description_en: As Minor Hypochondria, except the target believes himself to be suffering from a life threatening disease.

sp-06038.description_en: As Sensory Loss, except the target loses all senses (i.e., receives no sensory input whatsoever) for the duration of this spell.

sp-06039.description_en: As Wound A, except the apparent wound can be up to an 'E' severity critical.

sp-06040.description_en: As any one of the non-Wound spells on this list below 15th level, except the effect of the projection upon the target can be delayed up to 24 hours. At the time of casting, the caster must decide upon the trigger for the spell. The caster can choose one of the following as triggers for this spell: a) time period, b) specified movement, c) specified sound, d) specified touch, e) specified smell, or f) specified taste perceived by the target.

sp-06041.description_en: As any one of the non-Wound spells on this list below 15th level, except affects 5 targets. The caster makes one Base Attack Roll which is applied to all of the chosen targets.

sp-06042.description_en: As any one of the Wound spells on this list, except the effect of the Wound spell upon the target can be delayed up to 24 hours. At the time of casting, the caster must decide upon the trigger for the spell. The caster can choose one of the following as a trigger for this spell: a) time period, b) specified movement, c) specified sound, d) specified touch, e) specified smell, or f) specified taste perceived by the target.

sp-06043.description_en: As any of the Wound spells, except affects 5 targets. The caster makes one BAR which is applied to all of the chosen targets. Separate rolls are made to determine the nature of the apparent wound on each target.

sp-06044.description_en: As Projection V, except affects 10 targets.

sp-06045.description_en: As Wound V, except affects 10 targets.

sp-06046.description_en: As Projection V, except affects one target per level of the caster.

sp-06047.description_en: As Wound V, except affects one target per level of the caster.

sp-06429.description_en: Creates an invisible force shield in front of the caster. This functions as a normal shield (subtracting 25 from appropriate attacks, etc) except it does not occupy a hand. This spell cannot be combined with a “real” (i.e., physical) shield.

sp-06430.description_en: Causes target to appear blurred to attackers. This subtracts 10 from all attacks.

sp-06431.description_en: Caster enchants a suit of armor which is to become his “Personal Armor.” This spell reduces the Minimum Maneuver Penalty, the Maximum Maneuver Penalty, the Missile Attack Penalty, and the Quickness Penalty of the armor by 1 per level of the caster (at the time of casting the spell). If the caster gains in level, and he wishes to reduce the penalties (to reflect the caster's new level), he must recast this spell. None of the four modifiers may be reduced below zero using this spell. These benefits are only received when the suit of armor is worn by the owner. For the purposes of this spell, the suit of armor must be of AT 5 or higher (and does not apply to the caster's “natural” AT).

sp-06432.description_en: Creates greaves of force which protect the caster's legs and arms. These do not interfere with spellcasting or maneuvers, nor do they raise the caster's Defensive Bonus or Armor Type. For the purposes of critical resolution however, the caster should be treated as wearing full greaves protecting arms and legs, and material equivalent should be deemed as whichever of “leather” or “metal” is most beneficial to the caster for a given critical. The greaves cannot be combined with “real” (i.e., physical) greaves.

sp-06433.description_en: This temporarily enchants the caster's shield conferring a special bonus of +10 to DB.

sp-06434.description_en: This temporarily enchants the caster's Personal Armor conferring a special bonus of +10 to DB.

sp-06435.description_en: Creates a helm of force which protects the caster's head. This will not interfere with spellcasting or maneuvers, nor will it raise the caster's Defensive Bonus or Armor Type. For the purposes of critical resolution however, the caster should be treated as wearing a full metal helm. The helm cannot be combined with a “real” (i.e., physical) helm.

sp-06436.description_en: This spell allows the caster to don (put on) and doff (take off) his Personal Armor in one-fifth of the normal time. It will take a minimum of one full round to don or doff armor using this spell, and for the duration of this spell, all the caster's activity will be used in donning/doffing the armor.

sp-06437.description_en: This temporarily enchants the caster's shield conferring a special bonus of +20 to DB.

sp-06438.description_en: The caster's apparel (AT 1 or AT 2) is temporarily enchanted to protect as AT 8 for the duration of the spell.

sp-06439.description_en: This temporarily enchants the caster's Personal Armor conferring a special bonus of +20 to DB.

sp-06440.description_en: For the duration of the spell, the caster's Personal Armor is enchanted such that any concussion hit damage delivered against the caster is halved (round up). For example, if the caster would have otherwise have suffered 5 points of concussion hit damage, this spell would reduce it to 3 points. Note a strike delivering 1 hit is not reduced through this spell.

sp-06441.description_en: This temporarily enchants the caster's shield conferring a special bonus of +30 to DB.

sp-06442.description_en: For the duration of this spell, the caster's Personal Armor cannot be damaged through normal means or through sustaining hits or critical strikes. In addition, the Personal Armor receives an additional RR (at the level of the caster) against criticals, spells and Armor-slaying items which may destroy armor. This spell may also be cast separately upon the caster's shield to provide similar protection. Note that this does not necessarily protect the caster (just the armor).

sp-06443.description_en: The caster's apparel (AT 1 or AT 2) is temporarily enchanted to protect as AT 12 for the duration of the spell.

sp-06444.description_en: This temporarily enchants the caster's Personal Armor conferring a special bonus of +30 to DB.

sp-06445.description_en: For the duration of the spell, the caster's Personal Armor is enchanted such that any concussion hit damage delivered against the caster is reduced to a third (round up). For example, if the caster would have otherwise have suffered 5 points of concussion hit damage, this spell would reduce it to 2 points. Note a strike delivering 1 hit is not reduced through this spell.

sp-06446.description_en: The caster's apparel (AT 1 or AT 2) is temporarily enchanted to protect as AT 16 for the duration of the spell.

sp-06447.description_en: For the duration of the spell, the caster's Personal Armor is enchanted so that any elemental critical strike made against the caster is reduced by one level of severity. Thus an 'E' becomes a 'D', a 'D' becomes a 'C', a 'C' becomes a 'B', a 'B' becomes an 'A', and 'A' criticals have a special modifier of -25 to the roll. This spell is only effective against one type of Elemental attack (Heat, Cold, Electricity or Impact) chosen at time of casting (and will not protect against Mana or Void criticals from Arcane Companion).

sp-06448.description_en: The caster's apparel (AT 1 or AT 2) is temporarily enchanted to protect as AT 20 for the duration of the spell.

sp-06449.description_en: For the duration of the spell, the caster's Personal Armor is enchanted such that any mundane critical strike made against the caster is reduced by one level of severity. Thus an 'E' becomes a 'D', a 'D' becomes a 'C', a 'C' becomes a 'B', a 'B' becomes an 'A', and 'A' criticals have a special modifier of -25 to the roll. This spell is only effective against one type of mundane critical strike attack (e.g., any of Slash, Puncture, Krush, etc.) chosen at time of casting.

sp-06450.description_en: This spell is used to bond junior officers or troops to a superior officer (to allow the Enlisted target to be the target of higher level spells on this list). The caster may only have as many Enlisted troops at any given time as he has levels, but he may discharge an Enlisted soldier at any time. Otherwise the Enlistment lasts until the caster or the target is dead. The process takes 1 minute per level of the target.

sp-06451.description_en: Caster learns the exact number of viewed troops and their general type (e.g., 60% infantry, 20% cavalry, 20% archers). Typing is based on visible equipment (and may not be entirely accurate).

sp-06452.description_en: For the duration of this spell, the caster receives a special +25 bonus to all Signaling maneuvers. Spell does not provide the means (flags, trumpets, smoke signals etc).

sp-06453.description_en: The casting of this spell grants the caster a special bonus of +25 to his next History (Battles) maneuver (which must be made within one minute of casting this spell).
