sp-06454.description_en: The caster can mentally send one command (maximum of one word per level of the caster) to a single Enlisted target (within range of this spell). The target is under no compulsion to follow the command, but will know who is the sender of the message. Communication is strictly one way.

sp-06455.description_en: The casting of this spell grants the caster a special bonus of +50 to his next Military Organization maneuver (which must be made within one minute of casting this spell).

sp-06456.description_en: The caster is aware of the location of all living Enlisted targets within the area of effect for the duration of this spell.

sp-06457.description_en: The casting of this spell grants the caster a special bonus of +50 to his next Siege Engineering maneuver (which must be made within one minute of casting this spell).

sp-06458.description_en: The casting of this spell grants the caster a special bonus of +50 to his next Tactics maneuver (which must be made within one minute of casting this spell).

sp-06459.description_en: The casting of this spell grants the caster a special bonus of +50 to his next Leadership maneuver (which must be made within one minute of casting this spell).

sp-06460.description_en: As Mental Command, except the caster can mentally send a set of commands. The set of commands is limited to a maximum of one sentence per level of the caster.

sp-06461.description_en: For the duration of the spell, the caster's voice is amplified so that it can be heard over the din of battle in the given area. This spell confers no command ability but merely allows the caster to be heard.

sp-06462.description_en: As Mental Command, except any or all Enlisted targets can receive the command.

sp-06463.description_en: The casting of this spell grants the caster a special bonus of +75 to all Situational Awareness (Combat) maneuvers made during the duration of this spell.

sp-06464.description_en: Any or all Enlisted targets of the caster can be compelled to follow a command of the caster (maximum of one word per level of the caster) which is not totally alien to the targets, (i.e., no suicide suggestion, but extremely dangerous orders “Charge and attack the enemy archers on the hill” can be given). Note that the targets must be able to hear the command of the caster.

sp-06465.description_en: Caster may mentally communicate with a single Enlisted target within range while both concentrate. The target will be aware of who is attempting to communicate. Communication is two-way, with neither party being under any compulsion to obey the other.

sp-06466.description_en: When cast on Enlisted troops, this provides the targets with a special bonus of +50 to all RRs versus fear and charm attacks (and provides them with unshakable morale for the duration of this spell). This will rally even previously routed troops. This spell does not protect the targets against Order or Mission spells.

sp-06467.description_en: As Mental Orders, except any or all Enlisted targets can receive the orders.

sp-06468.description_en: When cast on Enlisted troops, this will make the caster aware of the individual Enlisted troops' views on a given issue.

sp-06469.description_en: As Battle Awareness I, except the caster is also aware of the general health status (unwounded, lightly or seriously wounded, unconscious, dying) of each Enlisted target for the duration of the spell.

sp-06470.description_en: As Battle Communication, except the caster may simultaneously mentally contact up to 1 Enlisted target per five levels of the caster (within range of this spell). Once established, communication is effectively a mental conference with all targets able to send and receive.

sp-06471.description_en: Any or all Enlisted targets of the caster will receive a bonus equal to the level of the caster to all melee attacks, missile attacks and moving maneuvers for the duration of this spell. The caster must be alive and visible for the benefits to be received, and the caster himself does not receive these benefits.

sp-06472.description_en: As Order, except the caster can give a set of commands (maximum of one sentence per level of the caster) to the Enlisted targets. (This can include “suicide missions”—“Defend this position against the enemy until you have killed all the members of the enemy forces”).

sp-06473.description_en: Allows caster to determine the status of a fortification or camp that is under siege or attack (e.g., the castle walls have been breached, but the inner bailey gates are still holding).

sp-06474.description_en: The caster is alerted if any sentient being enters or and/or exits (chosen at time of casting) the area. The alarm may be silent (empathic) or audible (volume of alarm chosen at time of casting). If set to be audible, the alarm will sound for 1 minute per level of the caster before stopping.

sp-06475.description_en: The caster may seal one breach in the defences of a camp or fortress by forming an impassible wall of force up to 10' by 10' in size. This wall can itself be breached if it sustains 10 hits per level of the caster. Otherwise it must be dispelled, bypassed, or its duration must expire.

sp-06476.description_en: This spell prevents all scrying magic from passing the barrier. Any scrying spell (this includes all informational spells) must make an RR versus the level of the caster (with a special modification of -30) or be cancelled. If the scrying spell makes its RR, it may cross the barrier unhindered.

sp-06477.description_en: This spell prevents all elemental magic from passing the barrier. Any elemental spell (this includes all spells of type E,BE and DE) must make an RR versus the level of the caster (with a special modification of -30) or be cancelled. If the elemental spell makes its RR, it may cross the barrier unhindered.

sp-06478.description_en: This spell prevents all transportation and gating magic from passing the barrier. Any such spell (this includes Teleport, Long Door, Leaving, etc.) must make an RR versus the level of the caster (with a special modification of -30) or be cancelled. If the transport spell makes its RR, it may cross the barrier unhindered.

sp-06479.description_en: Caster creates a dome of force around a given point (which may be on a mobile object) to protect an area. This force shield can sustain 10 hits per level of the caster before being destroyed. Otherwise it must be dispelled (or its duration must expire).

sp-06480.description_en: This spell prevents any sentient being from passing the barrier. Any being attempting to cross must make an RR versus a Mentalism spell attack (at the caster's level) with a special modification of -30. If the being makes its RR, the being may cross the barrier unhindered.

sp-06481.description_en: This spell prevents any spell of one specific realm (chosen at time of casting; may not select Arcane as the realm) from passing the barrier. Any such spell must make an RR versus the level of the caster (with a special modification of -30) or be cancelled. If the spell makes its RR, it may cross the barrier unhindered. .

sp-06482.description_en: The caster can create an impassable wall of force in any shape desired (with a maximum length 5' per level of the caster and height 10'; usually to surround a camp or fortification). The Palisade will protect the area. The Palisade can sustain 20 hits per level of the caster before being destroyed. As this is effectively a wall, attackers may fly over it, tunnel beneath it, or fire missiles over it. Any attempt to “climb” over it has such maneuvers modified by -75. Otherwise the Palisade must be dispelled (or its duration must expire).

sp-06483.description_en: As Alarm I, except for the area of effect.

sp-06484.description_en: As Spell Breach I, except up to three breaches may be simultaneously sealed, and each wall of force will be able to sustain 15 hits per level of the caster.

sp-06485.description_en: As Scrying Barrier, except for the area of effect and the duration.

sp-06486.description_en: As Element Barrier, except for the area of effect and the duration.

sp-06487.description_en: Caster creates an impassable spherical force

sp-06488.description_en: As Transport Barrier, except for the area of effect and the duration.

sp-06489.description_en: As Mantlet, except for the area of effect and the duration.

sp-06490.description_en: As Mind Barrier, except for the area of effect and the duration.

sp-06491.description_en: As Spell Barrier, except for the area of effect and the duration.

sp-06492.description_en: As Alarm I, except for the area of effect.

sp-06493.description_en: As Seal Breach I, except up to one breach per five levels of the caster may be simultaneously sealed, and each wall may sustain 20 hits per level of the caster.

sp-06494.description_en: As Palisade, except the maximum length of the wall is 20' per level of the caster, its height is 1' per level of the caster, and it may sustain 50 hits per level of the caster.

sp-06495.description_en: As Bastion, except for the area of effect, the duration, and the Bastion may now sustain 50 hits per level of the caster.

sp-06496.description_en: This spell allows the caster to march (moving at double normal base rate), with no exhaustion points spent, for the duration. If he stops, the spell is cancelled.

sp-06497.description_en: This spell reduces the difficulty of riding maneuvers by 3 categories for the duration of the spell (e.g., Very Hard (20) becomes Light (+10)). If the caster dismounts, the spell is cancelled.

sp-06498.description_en: This spell allows the caster to swim at base movement rate, with no exhaustion points spent, for the duration. If he stops swimming, the spell is cancelled.

sp-06499.description_en: This spell allows the caster's steed to move at double its base rate, with no exhaustion points spent, for the duration. If the steed stops, the spell is cancelled.

sp-06500.description_en: The caster may march at normal speed for the duration of this spell without making any sound. This will provide a special bonus of +10 to +50 to any Stalking maneuvers (GM discretion). If the caster stops marching, the spell is cancelled.

sp-06501.description_en: This spell allows the caster to swim at double his normal rate (i.e., as fast as he can run), with no exhaustion points spent, for the duration. If he stops swimming, the spell is cancelled.

sp-06502.description_en: This spell reduces the difficulty of moving maneuvers by 3 categories for the duration of the spell (e.g., Very Hard (-20) becomes Light (+10)). This spell can only assist with maneuvers made in in the same round as an attack is declared.

sp-06503.description_en: The caster's steed may move at its base movement rate for the duration of this spell with neither the caster nor the steed making any sound. If the caster dismounts this spell is cancelled.

sp-06504.description_en: This spell allows the caster to fly at a rate of 50' per round (about 3 mph) for the duration of the spell. If the caster stops flying, the spell is cancelled.

sp-06505.description_en: With this spell a caster can move one target a distance of 5' per level (of the caster) instantly. There can be intervening barriers if the caster specifies exact distances. If the arrival point coincides with solid or liquid material, the target

sp-06506.description_en: As Forced March, except caster can affect one target per level.

sp-06507.description_en: As Riding, except caster can affect one target per level.

sp-06508.description_en: As Swimming I, except caster can affect one target per level.

sp-06509.description_en: As Forced Ride, except caster can affect one steed per level.

sp-06510.description_en: As Rapid Deployment I, except caster can move 3 targets a distance of 15' per level instantly.

sp-06511.description_en: As Silent March, except caster can affect one target per level.

sp-06512.description_en: As Swimming II, except caster can affect one target per level.

sp-06513.description_en: As Battle Maneuver, except caster can affect one target per level.

sp-06514.description_en: As Silent Ride, except caster can affect one steed and rider per level.

sp-06515.description_en: As Rapid Deployment I, except caster can move 5 targets a distance of 25' per level instantly.

sp-06516.description_en: As Flight, except caster can affect one target per level.

sp-06517.description_en: As Rapid Deployment I, except caster can move 10 targets a distance of 50' per level instantly.

sp-06518.description_en: As Rapid Deployment I, except caster can move 1 target per level of the caster a distance of 100' per level instantly.

sp-06519.description_en: Caster can see 100' on a clear night as if it were day. At least some residual light is required for this spell to work.

sp-06520.description_en: Caster is protected from natural heat up to 170°F (treat as if caster were in 70˚F temperature). For temperatures above 170˚F, subtract 100°F to determine the effective temperature for the caster. Caster also receives +20 to all RRs versus heat spells and heat attacks (+20 DB versus elemental fire and heat attacks).

sp-06521.description_en: Caster is protected from natural cold down to 20°F (treat as if caster were in 70°F temperature). For temperatures below 20°F, add 50°F to determine the effective temperature for the caster. Caster also receives +20 to all RRs versus cold spells and cold attacks (+20 DB versus elemental cold and cold attacks).

sp-06522.description_en: Allows caster to go without food or water and not suffer damage as a result (i.e., provides nutrition and water for one day). If this spell is used for more than one day per level of the caster on a target, the target will start to suffer minor penalties from not eating (a cumulative -5 to all actions for that day; -10 on the next day; -15 on the next day; etc.).

sp-06523.description_en: Clots wound to reduce bleeding (i.e., hits per round) by one per every four full levels of the caster as long as caster concentrates or is immobile. Thus a 5th level caster could reduce bleeding by one hit per round (a 3 hits per round wound would become a 2 hits per round wound), whereas an 8th level caster could reduce bleeding by 2 hits per round (a 3 hits per round wound would become a 1 hit per round wound). Regardless of caster's level, this spell will always reduce bleeding by a minimum of one hit per round. This effect is permanent after 10 minutes (if the caster moves before this, the bleeding will resume at the previous rate). If caster is unconscious, the spell will operate without concentration.

sp-06524.description_en: Allows caster to land safely in a fall up to 20' per level, and to take that distance off the severity of any greater fall.

sp-06525.description_en: Caster is immediately refreshed, recovering all Exhaustion Points (up to his usual maximum). In addition, the caster is also cured of any minor intoxications (e.g., hangovers, etc.).

sp-06526.description_en: Relieves caster of one round's worth of accumulated stun per five full levels of the caster. Thus, an 8th level caster would be relieved of one round of stun, whereas a 10th level caster would be relieved of two rounds of stun. Regardless of caster's level, this spell will always relieve the caster of a minimum of one round's worth of accumulated stun.

sp-06527.description_en: Caster can breathe normally under water. This spell will not function with any liquid but water.

sp-06528.description_en: For every five full levels of the caster, the caster will heal one hit per minute of concentration. Thus, a 10th level caster could heal at a rate of 2 hits per minute, whereas a 15th level caster would heal at a rate of 3 hits per minute. Regardless of caster's level, this spell will always heal a minimum of one hit each minute. If the caster is unconscious, this spell will operate without concentration (ending when the caster reaches consciousness).

sp-06529.description_en: Caster is aware of any being within the area of effect that has hostile intentions towards him. The hostility must be directed specifically at the caster or the spell reveals nothing. The being's hostility must be active (i.e., driving the being to perform aggressive actions), not passive (i.e., hate exists, but no action is planned).

sp-06530.description_en: Will awake the caster from any unnatural sleep (e.g., Sleep spell, sleeping drug etc.). Caster takes one round to awaken.

sp-06531.description_en: For the duration of this spell, the caster receives an additional RR against any poison(s), and the effect of any poison which does enter or is already present in the caster's system is delayed for the duration.

sp-06532.description_en: For the duration of this spell, the caster receives an additional RR against any disease(s), and the effect of any disease which does enter or is already present in the caster's system is delayed for the duration.

sp-06533.description_en: The caster may ignore the effects of the first critical strike made against him. At the end of this spell's duration, all effects apply normally.

sp-06534.description_en: As Nightvision, except range is the range of normal daylight vision.

sp-06535.description_en: For the duration, the caster can breathe any gas as normal air.

sp-06536.description_en: As Detect Ambush I, except the area of effect is 100'R.

sp-06537.description_en: Caster may appear to be dead to all mundane and some magical means of detecting life. For the duration of this spell, the caster will be immobile, show no response to stimuli such as being struck, have no discernible pulse, will not appear to breathe, etc., nor will he possess any signs of mental activity detectable by Presence spells nor will he be detected by Detect Life spells. However Detect Mentalism, etc., spells will detect active magic. The duration of this spell is set at time of casting, and can only be terminated earlier than this by dispelling magic.

sp-06538.description_en: For the duration of this spell, the caster receives a special +25 bonus to RRs versus spells from a particular realm of power, chosen at time of casting. This spell will not function against the realm of Arcane.

sp-06539.description_en: As Awake, except there is no delay and it can be used with normal sleep and set to be triggered by any activity (e.g., attack, danger, etc.).

sp-06540.description_en: As Lion Heart I, except caster can ignore the effects of the first two critical strikes made against him.

sp-06541.description_en: For the duration of this spell, the caster is under the effects of Sustain Self, Heat Resistance, Cold Resistance, Poison Resistance, and Disease Resistance; except any bonuses granted from these spells is equal to +30 (this applies to Heat Resistance, Cold Resistance, Poison Resistance, and Disease Resistance).

sp-06542.description_en: Caster enchants a melee weapon which is to become his “Personal Weapon.” This spell grants the weapon a special bonus equal to +1 per level of the caster to any attacks made with this weapon. The cost to cast this spell is equal to the level of the caster. If the caster gains a level and he wishes the bonus to be increased, he must recast this spell. The weapon only gains its bonus in the hands of its owner. The special bonus is cumulative with any non-magical bonuses the weapon may possess (material, construction, and/or quality) but not with magical enhancements such as Bladerunes.

sp-06543.description_en: Caster adds 2 to his initiative roll next round.

sp-06544.description_en: The caster gains a surer grip on any weapon wielded during the spell duration, lowering its fumble range by 1 (to a minimum of 1).

sp-06545.description_en: The caster's Personal Weapon leaps into his hand, negating any penalties for drawing a weapon.

sp-06546.description_en: Caster “ties” his Personal Weapon to himself. The fumble range of the weapon will be raised by +1 per level of the caster for anyone other than the caster who attempts to wield the weapon in combat. If the caster gains in level, and he wishes the penalty to be increased as well, he must recast this spell.

sp-06547.description_en: Allows caster's Personal Weapon to cut wood as well as an axe, break stone as well as a mattock, or dig earth as well as a spade (must be designated at time of casting).

sp-06548.description_en: Caster adds 4 to his initiative roll next round.

sp-06549.description_en: If the caster makes an attack using his Personal Weapon, in the same round as this spell is cast and is successful in delivering concussion hit damage to his opponent, the amount of concussion hit damage will be doubled.

sp-06550.description_en: The caster gains a surer grip on any weapon wielded during the spell duration, lowering its fumble range by 2 (to a minimum of 1).

sp-06551.description_en: If the caster makes an attack using his Personal Weapon, in the same round as this spell is cast, any

sp-06552.description_en: Caster adds 6 to his initiative roll next round.

sp-06553.description_en: If the caster makes an attack using his Personal Weapon, in the same round as this spell is cast, and that attack delivers a critical strike to the opponent, an additional elemental critical (using the same roll) of two levels less in severity will be delivered. Thus an 'E' critical strike will yield an additional 'C' strike, a 'D' will yield an additional 'B', a 'C' will yield an additional 'A' critical, and 'A' and 'B' criticals will yield no extra critical. The type of elemental critical must be chosen at time of casting and may only be one of the following: Heat, Cold, Electricity or Impact (Mana and Void criticals from Arcane Companion may not be chosen).

sp-06554.description_en: The caster's Personal Weapon will fly through the air to his outstretched hand at a rate of 100' per round. Suitable barriers (with no openings that the weapon can physically fit through) will cause this spell to fail (e.g., the caster is in a windowless cell with a closed door).

sp-06555.description_en: For the duration of this spell, the caster's Personal Weapon cannot be broken normally (i.e., is not subject to the normal breakage rules). In addition, the Personal Weapon receives an additional RR (at the level of the caster) against criticals, spells and Weaponslaying items which break weapons.

sp-06556.description_en: If the caster makes an attack using his Personal Weapon, in the same round as this spell is cast, any critical strike will be treated as “Mithril” for the purposes of resolution (note that this is usually only applicable against Large and Super Large creatures).

sp-06557.description_en: The caster gains a surer grip on any weapon wielded during the spell duration, lowering its fumble range by 6 (to a minimum of 1).

sp-06558.description_en: Caster adds 8 to his initiative roll next round.

sp-06559.description_en: If the caster makes an attack using his Personal Weapon, in the same round as this spell is cast and is successful in delivering concussion hit damage to his opponent, the amount of concussion hit damage will be tripled.

sp-06560.description_en: As Elemental Strike I, except the critical is only one less in severity.

sp-06561.description_en: If the caster makes an attack using his Personal Weapon, in the same round as this spell is cast, any critical strike will be treated as “Holy” for the purposes of resolution (note that this is usually only applicable against Large and Super Large creatures).

sp-06562.description_en: As Elemental Strike I, except the critical is of equal severity.

sp-06563.description_en: If the caster makes an attack using his Personal Weapon, in the same round as this spell is cast, any critical strike will be treated as “Slaying” for the purposes of resolution (the creature type must be chosen at time of casting; note that this is usually only applicable against Large and Super Large creatures).

sp-06564.description_en: As any one of the Mighty Strike, Elemental Strike, or Chivalrous Blow spells per round (they may change each round).

sp-07074.description_en: This spell allows the caster to make a pact of friendship and mutual aid with one animal. The animal will kill and even sacrifice its own life willingly to fulfill its end of the pact. If either party is ever killed, the surviving member will be at -30 to all actions for one week, -20 to all actions for one week, and then at -10 to all actions for one week until the shock wears off. In addition to the friendship pact, the caster and the bonded animal can mentally communicate with each other within the bond range (normally 5' per level of the caster). Mentalism-based casters need not actually “speak” their communciation aloud, but non-Mentalism casters and the animals will find it necessary to speak (making whatever sounds the animal normally makes; the caster will understand the croaks, barks, or whatever as if they were speech). This spell does not grant either the caster or the animal the ability to communicate with other members of their partner's species. A caster may have up to one bonded animal per every five levels (round up), but each such bonding requires a separate casting of this spell. This spell does not provide the caster with an animal, and takes one hour to complete.

sp-07075.description_en: Detects if any animal in the area of effect is currently bonded. Caster may concentrate on a different 5'R each round.

sp-07076.description_en: Allows a bonded animal to go without food and water for one day without taking damage from lack of “real” nutrition.

sp-07077.description_en: For the duration of this spell, the bond range of the caster is extended to 10' per level.

sp-07078.description_en: Using this spell, the caster can heal the following injuries on any one of his bonded animals: d10 hits per level of the caster, a bleeding wound that is bleeding no more than 1 hit for every five full levels of caster (i.e., a sixth level caster could stop a 1 per round bleeding wound; while a tenth level caster could stop a 2 per round bleeding wound), or mild frostbite or burns (one area per level of the caster). For the purpose of this spell, an area of moderate frostbite or burn damage counts as two areas of mild damage, and an area of severe frostbite or burn damage counts as three areas of mild damage.

sp-07079.description_en: For the duration of this spell, caster can perceive the world through any or all of the senses of any one of his bonded animals. The caster is limited in perception by the limitations of the animal's senses (so if the animal has no color vision, the caster will not perceive color through the animal's eyes). The caster's understanding of the available sensory data is further limited to the perceptive faculties that he himself possesses (i.e., if the caster is borrowing the sonar sense of a bat and does not possess sonar himself, gibberish is received).

sp-07080.description_en: Caster can call (summon) any one of his bonded animals which will then try and come to him. The range of this call is ten times the caster's current bond range.

sp-07081.description_en: For the duration of this spell, the bond range of the caster is extended to 15' per level.

sp-07082.description_en: For the duration of this spell, the fact that the target animal is bonded to the caster is concealed from magical detection.

sp-07083.description_en: Using this spell, the caster can heal the following injuries on any one of his bonded animals (recovery time given in parentheses): one damaged muscle (1 hour), one damaged tendon (1 hour), one sprain (1 hour), any cartilage damage (1 hour), any one broken bone (1 day), or any one shattered bone or joint (1 week). This spell can only repair an injury (it cannot replace a body part).

sp-07084.description_en: The caster can choose to release any one of his bonded animals from the Bonding. The bonded animal may resist this spell. If released, the bonded animal may remain friendly to the caster but may not remain long in his presence (depending on the circumstances and its treatment during the bonded period).

sp-07085.description_en: For the duration of this spell, the bond range of the caster is extended to 20' per level.

sp-07086.description_en: Gives the direction and distance to any one of the caster's bonded animals.

sp-07087.description_en: Using this spell, the caster can heal the

sp-07088.description_en: For the duration of this spell, the bond range of the caster is extended to 25' per level.

sp-07089.description_en: For the duration of this spell, the caster and one of his bonded animals may interchange energy at a rate of up to one concussion hit per level of the caster or two exhaustion points per level of the caster (per round). This spell will not allow either party to gain more concussion hits or exhaustion points than their normal maximum.

sp-07090.description_en: The next spell with a fixed duration (i.e., not instant or concentration) to affect the caster will affect one of his bonded animals. The duration of the spell will be halved to reflect the sharing of magical energies. Thus, an Invisibility spell will last (at most) 12 hours. The bonded animal is subject to all the normal limitations on spells.

sp-07091.description_en: Using this spell, the caster can cure the following on any one of his bonded animals: one disease, one poison, or one mental illness. Any damage already sustained as a result of the disease, poison, or illness remains.

sp-07092.description_en: For the duration of this spell, the bond range of the caster is extended to 50' per level.

sp-07093.description_en: Using this spell, the caster can heal any injury on any one of his bonded animals, including regeneration of body parts. The recovery time will vary (d100 hours) depending on the nature of the injury (GM's discretion). If the injury is such that it would prove fatal to the bonded animal if not immediately healed, the bonded animal will remain unconsious for the duration of the recovery time (but will be healed of the damage at the end of the recovery time).

sp-07094.description_en: For the duration of this spell, the bond range of the caster is extended to 100' per level.

sp-07095.description_en: Caster studies and memorizes the form of one type of plant for use with other spells on this list.

sp-07096.description_en: Caster studies and memorizes the form of one type of animal for use with other spells on this list.

sp-07097.description_en: Caster can either increase his mass (and usually height) by 10% or reduce his mass (and usually height) by 10% per level (to a maximum of 90%). When increasing, there is no proportional increase in strength other than for movement purposes; when decreasing there is no proportional decrease in strength.

sp-07098.description_en: Caster studies and memorizes the form of one type of humanoid race for use with other spells on this list.

sp-07099.description_en: Caster studies and memorizes the form of one specific individual of a given humanoid race for use with other spells on this list.

sp-07100.description_en: Allows the caster to alter the features of his face in his current form. If he has used Study Person on a being, he can take on that being's exact facial form.

sp-07101.description_en: Allows the caster to alter his build in his current form (down to one-half and up to double current mass). If he has used Study Person on a being, he can take on that being's exact physical build.

sp-07102.description_en: Caster studies and memorizes the form of one type of magical, mythical, or legendary beast (e.g., Dragon, Unicorn, etc.) for use with other spells on this list.

sp-07103.description_en: Caster can shift his form to that of any one plant he has studied. The caster will look and feel like the plant, and will gain the scent and physical abilities of the plant.

sp-07104.description_en: Caster can shift his form to that of any one land-bound animal he has studied. The caster will look and feel like the animal, and will gain the scent, physical abilities, and movement abilities of the animal.

sp-07105.description_en: As Animal Shift I, except that the caster can shift to the form of a flying, gliding, or aquatic animal he has studied. Caster will gain the flight capabilities and/or water breathing abilities (increased lung capacity/gills) of the studied animal.

sp-07106.description_en: Caster can shift his form to that of any one humanoid race he has studied. The caster will look and feel like a member of that race, and will gain the scent, and movement abilities associated with that race. Includes flight capabilities and/or water breathing abilities if pertinent.

sp-07107.description_en: Allows the caster to alter exterior parts of his body such as skin color, hands to claws (or vice versa), adding/removing limbs or tails, etc. Caster may only make alterations using components of stored patterns (thus, a caster could only add a reptilian tail if he had previously stored a creature or being with a reptilian tail).

sp-07108.description_en: As Race Shift, except that the caster can shift his form to that of any one specific individual he has studied.

sp-07109.description_en: Caster can shift his form to that of any one landbound legendary, magical, or mythical beast he has studied. The caster will look and feel like the beast, and will gain the scent, physical abilities, and movement abilities of the beast.

sp-07110.description_en: As Plant Shift, except the caster also gains any perceptive abilities, movement abilities, physical attacks, and armor type of the studied plant.

sp-07111.description_en: As Partial Shift I, except the caster can alter the internals of his body (e.g., adjusting his eyes and brain for infravision, adding gills for underwater breathing, acquiring superior resistance to poison etc.), and alterations can only be made using components of stored patterns. Thus, a caster would need an Elf pattern stored, say, to alter his vision for Nightvision.

sp-07112.description_en: As Beast Shift I, except that the caster can shift to the form of a flying, gliding, or aquatic beast he has studied. Caster will gain the flight capabilities and/or water breathing abilities (increased lung capacity/gills) of the studied beast.

sp-07113.description_en: As either Animal Shift I or Animal Shift II, except the caster also gains the perceptive abilities, physical attacks, and natural armor type of the studied animal.

sp-07114.description_en: As Race Shift, except the caster also gains the perceptive abilities, racial physical abilities, any natural physical attacks (natural weaponry only ), and natural armor type of the studied race.

sp-07115.description_en: As Person Shift, except the caster also gains the perceptive abilities, racial physical abilities, any natural physical attacks, and natural armor type of the studied individual's race. At GM discretion, the caster may also gain any purely physical talents possessed by the studied individual, and/ or physical stat bonuses and penalties from the race.

sp-07116.description_en: As Beast Shift I or Beast Shift II, except the caster also gains the perceptive abilities, physical attacks, and natural armor type of the studied beast.

sp-07117.description_en: As any of the lower level Shift spells except the caster can change form to any Studied form (by concentrating for one round) at any time during the duration of this spell.

sp-07118.description_en: Allows the caster to gauge what the tastes of the target are (e.g., is he a collector of rare books, old maps or vintage wines, etc.).

sp-07119.description_en: The caster causes one target to perceive the item as the caster wishes. Any and all senses may be changed as the illusion is all in the target's mind. However the nature of the item may not be changed (e.g., a book will remain a book, a map will still be a map).

sp-07120.description_en: Causes the caster to be more convincing than normal, providing a +25 bonus to the caster's next attempt to influence someone verbally. This bonus lasts for the whole of the next attempt and may be applied to any appropriate maneuver (at the GM's discretion; e.g., Duping, Seduction etc.).

sp-07121.description_en: As Item Charade I, except allows the caster to completely change how he is physically perceived by one target.

sp-07122.description_en: Caster's skin becomes sensitive to magic. Whenever a spell is cast on him during the duration of this spell, his skin will tingle. He will gain no information about the spell at all, only that he was the target of magic.. This will detect even Passive or Informational spells.

sp-07123.description_en: As Item Charade I, except the target will perceive any one animal as any animal of the same type (e.g., a cat will still look like a cat, but it can be any type of cat of the same basic size).

sp-07124.description_en: Causes the next lie the caster tells to be free of the normal signs used to detect lies. This results in a special modification of -25 to any non-magical attempts at lie detection and a special bonus of +25 to any RRs versus magical attempts at lie detection.

sp-07125.description_en: Allows the caster to alter one of the following to magical/mental detections: his race, profession, or level.

sp-07126.description_en: As Minor Magic Sense, except the caster's skin is sensitive enough to detect magic in or on objects which he touches.

sp-07127.description_en: As Item Charade I, except the caster can affect 2 targets.

sp-07128.description_en: As Loquaciousness I, except the bonus is +50.

sp-07129.description_en: As Personal Charade I, except the caster can affect 2 targets.

sp-07130.description_en: As Creature Charade I, except the caster can affect 2 targets.

sp-07131.description_en: As Lesser Magic Sense, except the caster learns the realm of magic and the direction from whence the spell came (if appropriate). 15.Mental Charade II—As Mental Charade I, except the caster can alter two of the following to magical/mental detections: his level, race, or profession. Alternatively, the caster can choose only one of the items and double the duration of this spell.

sp-07133.description_en: As Item Charade I, except the caster can affect 3 targets.

sp-07134.description_en: As Loquaciousness I, except the bonus is +75.

sp-07135.description_en: As Personal Charade I, but the caster can affect 3 targets.

sp-07136.description_en: As Creature Charade I, except the caster can affect 3 targets.

sp-07137.description_en: As Greater Magic Sense, except the caster can choose an area in which to detect. He will detect any spells cast on the area after this spell is cast and any magic items that enter the area (but will not discover any magics which encompass an area larger than this spell).

sp-07138.description_en: As Mental Charade I, except the caster can alter his race, profession, and level to magical and mental detections. Alternatively, the caster can choose two of the above and double the normal duration; or the caster can choose only one of the above and triple the normal duration.

sp-07139.description_en: As Item Charade I, except the caster can manipulate the perceptions of a number of targets up to a maximum of caster's level divided by 5.

sp-07140.description_en: As Personal Charade I, except the caster can manipulate the perceptions of a number of targets up to a maximum of caster'a level divided by 5.

sp-10381.description_en: This subconsciously activated spell will awaken the caster from any form of sleep (magical or nonmagical). The caster will require only one round to come fully awake. This spell works by assimilating sensory cues from the caster's surroundings and allowing the caster's subconscious to determine if the caster should awaken in response.

sp-07184.description_en: When cast on a target before sleep, this spell prevents the target's dream self from entering or being drawn into the dream world for the duration of the target's sleep period.

sp-07185.description_en: When cast on a target (either before or after entry to the dream world), this spell allows the target to use his skills and innate abilities at 25% of their normal value within the dream world (for the duration of this spell). This spell does not allow the caster to cast spells while in the dream world. Without an Empowerment spell, a dream-self persona cannot manipulate the dream world.

sp-07186.description_en: For the duration of this spell, the target is able to cast first level spells while in the dream world. This spell can be cast either before or after entry to the dream world. Without this spell, the target's spells will have no effect in the dream world.

sp-07187.description_en: Allows the caster to slow down the metabolism of the target's real body for the duration of the spell. The target's body does not require nourishment for the duration of the spell. The spell only functions while the target remains in the dream world.

sp-07188.description_en: World—Allows the caster to draw the dream self of a sleeping target into a specific location in the dream world chosen at time of casting. The target will remain in the dream world for the duration of his sleep, unless an Exit Dream World spell

sp-07189.description_en: Allows the caster to force a target's dream self out of the dream world. The target will waken in one round after being ejected. This spell cannot be used to eject a creature belonging to the dream world.

sp-07190.description_en: As Dream Empowerment I, except the target can use his skills and abilities at 50% of their normal value.

sp-07191.description_en: As Dream Spell I, except the target can cast up to thirrd level spells.

sp-07192.description_en: When cast on a target, this spell will provide the target's subconscious mind with a warning of any danger to the target's physical body for the duration of the spell.

sp-07193.description_en: The caster may teleport one target to a location within the dream world with which the caster is either familiar or is familiar with its real world equivalent. The risk of this spell depends on the caster's familiarity with the destination. The following chances for failure exist: Never seen place (but has had described) = 50%; Been briefly (one hour or less) = 25%; Studied (been in for 24 hours)=10%; Studied carefully (7 days) = 1 %. In the case of failure, first determine the direction of the error (roll randomly) The amount of error is then determined by making a d100 (openended) roll to determine the distance of the error in feet.

sp-07194.description_en: This spell will inform the caster of the location in the dream world of the dream-self of a single chosen target who must be in the dream world at time of casting and known to the caster.

sp-07195.description_en: As Dream Spell I, except the target can cast up to fifth level spells.

sp-07196.description_en: As Dream Empowerment I, except the target can use his skills and abilities at 75% of their normal value.

sp-07197.description_en: Allows the caster to summon a dream beast. The dream beast may or may not be friendly towards the caster, and the caster may or may not be able to summon a specific type or individual dream beast dependent on the nature of the dream world.

sp-07198.description_en: The target's dream-self will be prevented from returning to his physical body. The target may make additional RRs to break free if the physical body is attacked or endangered during the duration of this spell.

sp-07199.description_en: As Summon Dream Beast, except the caster can summon an intelligent denizen of the dream world.

sp-07200.description_en: The target dream beast will believe the caster is a good friend.

sp-07201.description_en: As Dream Spell I, except the target can cast up to tenth level spells.

sp-07202.description_en: As Charm Dream Beast, except this spell affects intelligent denizens of the dream world.

sp-07203.description_en: As Dream Empowerment I, except the target can use his skills and abilities at 100% of their normal value.

sp-07204.description_en: As Dream Teleport I, except the caster may teleport up to one target per level of the caster.

sp-07205.description_en: As Dream Spell I, except the target can cast up to twentieth level spells.

sp-07206.description_en: As Dream Spell I, except the target can cast up to fiftieth level spells.

sp-07207.description_en: Adds +20 to the caster's Appearance. This cannot raise the caster's Appearance above 100.

sp-07208.description_en: Caster learns details about the target's romantic emotional attachments (if any) and sexual preferences.

sp-07209.description_en: Adds +25 to any Seduction maneuvers for the duration of this spell.

sp-07210.description_en: The target will believe everything the caster says, unless the target has prior (or incontrovertible evidence) to the contrary.

sp-07211.description_en: Caster studies and memorizes the appearance and mannerisms of a being, for later use in a Face Shifting True or Change type spell. The caster can only have as many forms studied as he has levels.

sp-07212.description_en: Allows the caster to alter the form of his face. If he has used Study Individual, he can take on the exact facial form.

sp-07213.description_en: Adds +15 to any maneuvers using any skill in the Influence skill category (except Seduction).

sp-07214.description_en: The caster receives a +15 bonus to all performing skills (in the Artistic • Active category) for the duration of this spell.

sp-07215.description_en: As Face Shifting True, except the caster can alter his build and the shape of his body.

sp-07216.description_en: As Enhance Beauty I, except the bonus is +40 and the maximum is 101.

sp-07217.description_en: Caster can alter his entire body to the form of another humanoid race (no increase in mass). This spell is insufficient in itself to allow the caster to impersonate a specific being.

sp-07218.description_en: As Entertain I, except the bonus is +30.

sp-07219.description_en: As Influence I, except the bonus is +30.

sp-07220.description_en: Caster changes to become a member of the opposite sex in terms of purely physical factors. The caster is sterile for the duration of this spell. This spell can be used in combination with Racial Change and other spells.

sp-07221.description_en: As Seduction I, except the bonus is +50.

sp-07222.description_en: As Entertain I, except the bonus is +45.

sp-07223.description_en: Caster may appear to be any age desired, chosen at time of casting.

sp-07224.description_en: As Enhance Beauty I, except the bonus is +40 and the maximum is 103.

sp-07225.description_en: As Influence I, except the bonus is +45.

sp-07226.description_en: As Entertain I, except the bonus is +60.

sp-07227.description_en: As Seduction I, except the bonus is +75.

sp-07228.description_en: As Change Sex, except the caster becomes a true member of the opposite sex (i.e., genetics, personality, and all psychological factors are also changed, and the caster may choose whether to be sterile for the duration (choice must be made at time of casting).

sp-07229.description_en: Caster has two years of his age “removed” (i.e., rejuvenation). If the spell fails, the caster is killed and the total true age returns immediately. The spell may be cast repeatedly and effects are cumulative; however, each time it is cast on the caster, the unmodified failure chance increases by 1.

sp-07230.description_en: The target believes the caster is a good friend.

sp-07231.description_en: The target loses 20% of his remaining concussion hits.

sp-07233.description_en: The target is in “seventh heaven” (i.e., extreme ecstasy, joy, etc.), and may only spend 50% activity for the duration of this spell (i.e., he does not have a full 100% activity each round). The pleasure engendered is addictive and the target may act irrationally or allow himself to be manipulated to obtain a further “dose.”

sp-07234.description_en: As Kiss of Pain, except the target loses 40% of his remaining hits.

sp-07235.description_en: The target falls into a deep natural sleep. The first d10 rounds are magical (i.e., the target cannot be awakened by normal means).

sp-07236.description_en: The target is extremely jealous of a person chosen by the caster and will act on this emotion according to his (the target's) nature.

sp-07237.description_en: As Kiss of Pain, except the target loses 60% of his remaining hits.

sp-07238.description_en: The target feels physically drained. His Strength stat bonus reduced by 10.

sp-07239.description_en: Enables the next Kiss spell (if cast within 1 minute) to affect a target of the same sex and race as the caster.

sp-07241.description_en: As Kiss of Pain, except the target loses 90% of his remaining hits.

sp-07242.description_en: As Kiss of Impotence, except the duration is permanent.

sp-07243.description_en: The target will obey the caster in any suggested act that is not completely alien to him (e.g., no suicide orders, no blinding himself, etc.).

sp-07244.description_en: As Minor Kiss, except enables the next Kiss spell (if cast within 1 minute) to affect a target of any sex belonging to another humanoid race.

sp-07245.description_en: As Kiss of Jealousy, except the emotion is hate.

sp-07246.description_en: The target is an amnesiac, remembering nothing of his past for the duration of his spell.

sp-07247.description_en: As Kiss of Jealousy, except the emotion is love.

sp-07248.description_en: The target falls into a deep coma.

sp-07249.description_en: As Minor Kiss, except enables the next Kiss spell (if cast within 1 minute) to affect any sentient target of any sex.

sp-07250.description_en: Causes the effect of the next Kiss spell (if cast within 1 minute) to be delayed for up to 1 minute per level of the caster.

sp-07251.description_en: Causes the next Kiss spell (if cast within 1 minute) to have a range of 50'.

sp-07252.description_en: As Kiss of Coma, except the target will die immediately if he fails his RR by more than -50.

sp-07253.description_en: Allows caster virtual totall recall of any conversation or writing he encountered within a period of days equal to his level.

sp-07254.description_en: Doubles the rate at which the caster can learn a language. Every rank of language developed (i.e., DPs spent), results in two ranks being learned. It is assumed that this spell is cast and in effect while the language is being learned.

sp-07255.description_en: Caster learns what language a piece of text is written in, and the author if he was noteworthy or the caster has seen his work previously.

sp-07256.description_en: Caster can read at three times the normal rate (resulting in 3 pages per minute while this spell is active).

sp-07257.description_en: Allows the caster to access his memory as if he had total recall. Any manuever involving Memory receives a special bonus of +25.

sp-07258.description_en: Caster gains information regarding one manuscript including type of paper/parchment, type of binding (if any), type of ink, date of writing/printing, date of binding (if any), magical or normal, etc. No information will be provided on the content of the text.

sp-07259.description_en: Caster gains insights or facts by observing a person or thing with intense concentration. Gives the caster a +50 modification to an appropriate Awareness maneuver.

sp-07260.description_en: As Learn Language II, except rate is tripled (and three ranks are gained for every one).

sp-07261.description_en: Caster can read at five times the normal rate (resulting in 5 pages per minute while this spell is active).

sp-07262.description_en: Caster is able to correlate known facts to obtain conclusions. Any maneuver involving Reasoning receives a special bonus of+25.

sp-07263.description_en: Caster can read a piece of text and tell if it is a translation: and if so, what the original language was and possibly the author if he was noteworthy or the caster has seen his work before.

sp-07264.description_en: This spell copies a document that the caster is examining. The caster merely concentrates and touches the document with one hand and a blank sheet with his other hand. The copy is exact and in full color. Note the caster does not have to be able to read the document. The process occurs at a rate of one page per round.

sp-07265.description_en: Allows caster to reduce the effects of time upon a given book, scroll, or parchment (and similar objects) by one year per caster's level. This spell will

sp-07266.description_en: Caster can read at ten times the normal rate (resulting in 10 pages per minute while this spell is active).

sp-07267.description_en: As Learn Language II, except rate is four times normal (and four ranks are gained for every one).

sp-07268.description_en: As Recall I, except the bonus of +50. Not cumulative with Recall I.

sp-07269.description_en: As Study II, except caster can read as fast as he can glance at a page.

sp-07270.description_en: As Observation I, except virtually every detail in even a large situation is noted, and the bonus is +100. Not cumulative with Observation I.

sp-07271.description_en: As Passage Origin I, except the caster can tell how many times the text has been translated, what languages the text has been through, who the translators were, and who the original author was.

sp-07272.description_en: As Correlations I, except the bonus is +50. Not cumulative with Correlations I.

sp-07273.description_en: As Learn Language II, except rate is five times normal (and five ranks are gained for every one).

sp-07274.description_en: As Revitalise Manuscript I, except the time reduction is ten years per caster's level.

sp-07275.description_en: As Learn Language II, except rate is ten times normal (and ten ranks are gained for every one).

sp-07276.description_en: Caster learns if any illness or disease is effecting the target. Caster also learns the number of illnesses/diseases, but not their nature.

sp-07277.description_en: Caster learns if any poison is effecting the target. Caster also learns the number of toxins, but not their nature.

sp-07278.description_en: Caster learns if any physical malady (i.e., broken bone, sprains, tendon/muscle damage, internal bleeding etc. but not diseases or poisons) is effecting the target. Caster also learns the number of illnesses/diseases and a general location of each malady.

sp-07279.description_en: Creates clean incision into living material a predetermined length and depth. The incision will not bleed for the duration of the spell.

sp-07280.description_en: Closes any one wound (leaving only a small scar). In the case of a normal wound (i.e., not caused by an Incision), the binding should be treated as a sewn wound (which may reopen under stress).

sp-07281.description_en: Removes any foreign material from an open wound.

sp-07282.description_en: Caster learns if any mental illness or disease is affecting the target. Caster also learns the number of such problems, but not their nature.

sp-07283.description_en: Stops infection/spread of one disease in the target. No further damage will occur in uninfected areas of the body for the duration of this spell. Damage already sustained is not cured. The disease must be specified at time of casting. This spell can be used preemptively to prevent the infection of a healthy person (this results in any RRs versus the specified disease being modifiedy by +50).

sp-07284.description_en: Allows the caster to set any bone or joint (simple or compound fracture, or shatters) in the correct position for natural healing. Appropriate support will be necessary to ensure the bone or joint stays in place until healing is well underway.

sp-07285.description_en: Stabilises one poison in the system of the target. No further damage will occur for the duration of this spell. Damage already sustained is not cured. The poison must be specified at time of casting. This spell can be used preemptively to prevent the infection of a healthy person (this results in any RRs versus the specified poison being modifiedy by +50).

sp-07286.description_en: Caster acquires complete knowledge of one diesase affecting the target including name, type, and expected effect(s) of the disease, and cure and necessary treatment required. The spell does not give the caster the skill, the power or the materials to effect the cure.

sp-07287.description_en: Caster acquires complete knowledge of one poison effecting the target including name, type, and expected effect(s) of the poison, and cure and necessary treatment required. The spell does not give the caster the skill, the power or the materials to effect the cure.

sp-07288.description_en: Allows a caster to completely clean one wound of any type of natural infection. The spell will not keep an open wound clean and it will be necessary to remove the material causing the infection.

sp-07289.description_en: Caster acquires complete knowledge of one physical malady affecting the target including name, type, exact location and expected effect(s) of the malady, and cure and necessary treatment required. The spell does not give the caster the skill, the power, the tools or the materials to effect the cure.

sp-07290.description_en: The caster can revive the target after any sudden lapse in bodily functions (due to drowning, heart attack, shock, etc.), but the bodily functions cannot have lapsed for more than 1 round per level of the caster. This spell will restore bodily functions to normal heart rate, breathing, etc. Body must have proper attention and the cause of the lapse must be removed to prevent a recurrence.

sp-07291.description_en: Caster acquires complete knowledge of one mental problem affecting the target including name, type, and expected effect(s) of the malady, and cure and necessary treatment required. The spell does not give the caster the skill, the power or the materials to effect the cure.

sp-07292.description_en: Completely numbs part or all of a target's body for surgical procedures for the duration of the spell. The target is not rendered unconscious.

sp-07293.description_en: Will perfectly preserve a body or portion thereof (even if the portion is separated from a living host). The tissue is preserved in exactly the same condition it was in at time of casting.

sp-07294.description_en: Gives the caster a mental “still picture” of the interior of a target's body, which may be of the entire body or a specific region. If the picture is of the entire body, it will reveal broken bones, massive trauma etc, while if it is of a specific bodily part, it may show detail at the level of blocked blood vessels, damaged muscles etc.

sp-07295.description_en: Caster causes the target to become transparent and insubstantial, allowing the caster to imbed his hands inside the target, without causing any harm, and perform minor surgery or remove alien objects (caster can concentrate to make any portion of the target substantial enough to perform the surgery or procedure). Caster must still use any required tools or spells. The spell only affects living tissue.

sp-07296.description_en: As Local Anesthesia, except the target is rendered deeply unconscious for the duration.

sp-07297.description_en: As Resuscitation, except the lapse can be up to 1 minute per level of the caster.

sp-07298.description_en: Caster gains and stores all mental and emotional information about target. This information is only accessible via the higher level spells on this list.

sp-07299.description_en: Allows caster to know the general emotions/outlook of a studied humanoid, either in terms of a typical member of the race or the specific individual.

sp-07300.description_en: Allows caster to know the general emotions/outlook of a studied sentient plant, animal or beast, either in terms of a typical member of the species or the specific individual.

sp-07301.description_en: Allows caster to know the gender, race, profession and level (if any) of a studied individual at time of Study.

sp-07302.description_en: Allows caster to know the number, nature, and value of all skills (excluding spell lists; if any) possessed by a studied individual at time of Study.

sp-07303.description_en: Allows caster to know the number, nature, and levels known of all spell lists (if any) and special mental abilities (if any) possessed by an individual at time of Study.

sp-07304.description_en: Caster can consult the conscious memories and experiences of a studied individual at a rate of one “scene” per round.

sp-07305.description_en: Caster can mimic the emotions/outlook of a studied humanoid, either in terms of a typical member of the race or the specific individual.

sp-07306.description_en: Caster can mimic the emotions/outlook of a studied sentient plant, animal or beast, either in terms of a typical member of the species or the specific individual.

sp-07307.description_en: Caster can mentally become the gender, race, level and/or profession of any Studied race or individual, and will register as such by magical detections. Caster retains his own skills, profession, and racial bonuses. Also, any attribute that the caster does not choose to shift, he will retain. For example, a male Gnomish Shapeshifter (10th level Mentalist) has previously Studied a female Wood Elf Ranger (12th level), and now elects to Mental Shift, choosing to shift only race and profession. Assuming the spell is successful, he will now detect as a male 10th level Wood Elf Ranger (and may think like a Wood Elf Ranger).

sp-07308.description_en: Caster can draw upon the conscious memories of the Studied pattern in response to current stimuli.

sp-07309.description_en: Caster can use the studied individual's native language to the level of fluency (spoken and written) of the individual at time of Study.

sp-07310.description_en: Caster can use one purely mental skill (a skill that uses any combination of the following stat bonuses: Memory, Reasoning, Empathy, Intuition, or Presence) of a Studied individual at the skill bonus of that individual at time of Study.

sp-07311.description_en: Caster can use one non-combat (not OB related) physical or mental skill of a Studied individual at the skill bonus of that individual at time of Study.

sp-07312.description_en: Caster can use one combat skill (OB related) of a Studied individual at the skill bonus of that individual at time of Study.

sp-07313.description_en: Caster may use one spell list known by a Studied individual to the level known by that individual at time of Study. However, the caster must use his own PPs and must always make a Spell Casting Static Maneuver, with all appropriate penalties taken into consideration. Should the spell casting maneuver fail, the spell failure roll will receive a special modification of +50.

sp-07314.description_en: Caster can use any language known by the studied individual to the level of fluency (spoken and written) of the individual at time of Study.

sp-07315.description_en: As Skill Shift I, except the caster can use up to one purely mental skill per level from a single Studied individual.

sp-07316.description_en: As Skill Shift II, except the caster can use up to one non-combat physical or mental skill per level from a single Studied individual.

sp-07317.description_en: As Skill Shift III, except the caster can use up to one combat skill per level from a single Studied individual.

sp-07318.description_en: As Mystical Shift I, except the caster can use up to one spell list per level from a single Studied individual.

sp-07319.description_en: As any of the lower level Shift spells except caster can mind shift to a different pattern at any time during the 24 hours by concentrating for one full round.

sp-07320.description_en: Allows caster to determine from a sample the nature of a medicine or poison including origins, purity, general value, effect, plus type and antidote (if any) in the case of poisons.

sp-07321.description_en: Caster produces one dose of a medication which acts as an analgesic, providing temporary relief from minor muscular pain (i.e., allowing the beneficiary to ignore any one penalty of -10 or less due to muscular pain). The effects will last ten minutes per level of the caster.

sp-07322.description_en: Caster produces one dose of a medication which will temporarily alleviate one symptom of a minor ailment or illness (determined at time of casting). Examples include alleviating the queasiness and vertigo associated with nausea, alleviating sneezing, rashes, watery eyes etc. associated with an allergic reaction (because of pollen, animal hair, etc.), reducing a fever by one degree per level of the caster etc. The effects will last ten minutes per level of the caster.

sp-07323.description_en: Caster produces one dose of a medication which acts as an anesthetic, inducing unconsciousness, stupor, or insensitivity to pain (rendering the patient unable to act). The effects will last ten minutes per level of the caster.

sp-07324.description_en: Caster produces one dose of a medication which will reduce the effects of an infection or parasitic infestation,, killing bacteria, viruses, or parasites on contact. The effects will last thirty minutes per level of the caster.

sp-07325.description_en: Caster produces one dose of an antidote to one specific poison (of 10th level or less). The specific poison must be specified at time of casting. Damage already sustained is not cured. This spell has its failure chance raised by 1 per level of the poison.

sp-07326.description_en: Caster produces one dose of a medication which will either render the target fertile or infertile. A fertility medication will ensure conception will occur, whereas an infertility medication will act as a contraceptive. The effects will last one day per level of the caster.

sp-07327.description_en: Caster produces a medication which will cure any one disease (of 10th level or less). The specific disease

sp-07328.description_en: Caster produces a medication which will heal 3d10 concussion hits.

sp-07329.description_en: Caster produces a medication which will stop any blood loss from one wound.

sp-07330.description_en: Caster produces a physick which will heal any one area of skin damage (scarring, burn, etc.). The recovery period is up to an hour (depending on the severity of the injury).

sp-07331.description_en: Caster produces a medication which will repair damaged cartilage. The recovery period is one day.

sp-07332.description_en: Caster produces a physick which will heal any hair or nail loss or damage. The recovery period is one day.

sp-07333.description_en: Caster produces a physick which will repair a damaged muscle. The recovery period is up to 10 hours dependent on the severity of the injury.

sp-07334.description_en: Caster produces a physick which will repair a damaged tendon. The recovery period is up to 10 hours dependent on the severity of the injury.

sp-07335.description_en: Caster produces a medication which will repair a damaged, broken (simple or compound fractures) or shattered bone (but not joints). The recovery period is up to 10 days dependent on the severity of the damage (e.g., a simple fracture would take one day, a shattered bone ten days to heal).

sp-07336.description_en: As Lesser Antidote, except the poison can be any level.

sp-07337.description_en: As Lesser Disease Curative, except the disease can be of any level.

sp-07338.description_en: Caster produces a medicine which repairs a damaged nerve. The recovery period is one day.

sp-07339.description_en: Caster produces a medication which will repair a damaged, broken (simple or compound fracture) or shattered joint. The recovery period is up to 10 days dependent on the severity of the damage (e.g., a chipped joint would take one day, a shattered joint ten days to heal).

sp-07341.description_en: Caster produces a physick which will repair any one damaged organ (except the brain). The recovery period is up to 10 days dependent on the severity of the injury.

sp-07342.description_en: Caster produces a physick which will heal any damage to the brain, restoring memory loss and removing insanity (but not posssession or mental curses).The recovery period is up to days dependent on the severity of the injury.

sp-07343.description_en: Allows caster to know his current location in the ocean to within ±d10 miles. The caster can also tell which way is north.

sp-07344.description_en: Allows caster to determine the height of the tide, whether it is coming in or going out, the maximum height (or depth) and the time it will reach apogee (or perigee).

sp-07345.description_en: Allows the caster to determine the depth of the water within range at any point. The information will include maximum, minimum, and average depth.

sp-07346.description_en: Caster can see 100' on a clear night as if it were day. At least some residual light is required for this spell to work.

sp-07347.description_en: This spell allows the caster to swim at double his normal base movement rate (i.e., as fast as he can run), with no exhaustion points spent, for the duration. If he stops swimming, the spell is cancelled.

sp-07348.description_en: This spell allows the caster to row at double normal rate, with no exhaustion points spent, for the duration. If he stops rowing, the spell is cancelled.

sp-07349.description_en: This spell allows the caster to make no sound while rowing at the normal rate for the duration (i.e., there will be no sound from the rowlocks nor from the entry/exit of the oar into the water). If he stops rowing, the spell is cancelled.

sp-07350.description_en: As Nightvision, except caster can see 100' in any precipitation or gas.

sp-07351.description_en: This spell allows the caster to make no sound while swimming at normal rate, and “camouflages” the caster against the water, making him difficult to spot (-50 to Awareness maneuvers to notice the caster). If the caster stops swimming, the spell is cancelled.

sp-07352.description_en: For the duration of this spell, the caster receives a special +25 bonus to all Sailing maneuvers.

sp-07353.description_en: Caster may run on water (i.e., move at double his normal base pace) and will expend exhaustion points as normal. GMs may require maneuver rolls if the water is rough.

sp-07354.description_en: For the duration of this spell, the caster receives a special +25 bonus to all Drafting, Mapping, and/ or Cartography maneuvers.

sp-07355.description_en: For the duration of this spell, the caster can see underwater to a distance of 10'/lvl (some residual light must be available). In addition, the caster may also breathe water as well as air.

sp-07356.description_en: For the duration of this spell, the caster receives a special +25 bonus to all Navigation maneuvers.

sp-07357.description_en: As Nightvision and Fogvision, except the caster's range of vision is normal daylight range (i.e., to the horizon).

sp-07358.description_en: For the duration of this spell, the caster receives a special +25 bonus to all Boat Piloting maneuvers.

sp-07359.description_en: As Swimming II, except caster can affect one target per level.

sp-07360.description_en: As Forced Row, except caster can affect one target per level.

sp-07361.description_en: As Silent Row, except caster can affect one target per level.

sp-07362.description_en: As Ghost Swim, except caster can affect one target per level.

sp-07363.description_en: As Water Running, except caster can affect one target per level.

sp-07364.description_en: As Water Survival, except caster can affect one target per level.

sp-07365.description_en: For the duration of this spell, the caster receives a special +50 bonus to all Sailing, Drafting, Mapping, Cartography, Navigation and Boat Pilot maneuvers.

sp-07366.description_en: Gives caster a 95% chance of predicting the time (±15 minutes), direction (within one point on the compass), and speed of winds (±5 mph) over the next 24 hour period in an area designated at time of casting.

sp-07367.description_en: Gives caster a 95% chance of predicting the time (±15 minutes) and type of precipitation over the next 24 hour period in an area designated at time of casting.

sp-07368.description_en: Gives caster a 95% chance of predicting the time (±15 minutes) and type of storms over the next 24 hour period in an area designated at time of casting.

sp-07369.description_en: Gives caster a 95% chance of predicting the time (±15 minutes), type, and severity of weather over the next 24 hour period in an area designated at time of casting.

sp-07370.description_en: All fog or mist in the area is dissipated. Magically created fog or mist may receive an RR (GM's discretion).

sp-07371.description_en: Caster causes fog to arise that obscures all vision in and through the area. Normal vision inside the fog is limited to approximately 1'. All missile attacks into or out of the fog are modified at -10 to -50 (GM discretion).

sp-07372.description_en: The area of effect for this spell is 1' per level around the boat that the

sp-07373.description_en: As Predict Weather I, except the area of the forecast is 3 miles per level of the caster in radius.

sp-07374.description_en: As Waveshield, except this spell protects the ship from all inclement weather (but not winds). Thus fogs, mists, rain, snow etc., will not affect the ship (i.e., no rain will fall in the protected area, fog will remain outside the protected area). Weather created as a result of magic may receive an RR (GM's discretion).

sp-07375.description_en: The area of effect for this spell is the water immediately surrounding the boat or ship the caster is on. For as long as the caster concentrates, the speed of the ship or boat can be increased by 50' per round (approximately 3 miles per hour).

sp-07376.description_en: As Clear Fog, except for the area.

sp-07377.description_en: As Predict Weather I, except for the area.

sp-07378.description_en: As Call Fog, except for the area.

sp-07379.description_en: As Weathershield, except this spell protects the ship from all inclement weather including storms, gales, and winds.

sp-07380.description_en: Caster may control the speed and direction of the wind. Caster can increase or decrease wind speed by 1 mph times his level (e.g., assuming the current wind speed was 20 mph, a 15th level caster could set the wind speed to any speed between 5 mph and 35 mph). By directing the wind against missile attacks, he can cause a -1 modification for each mph of wind. Note that the caster can also control the direction of the flow of gases and/or clouds. The caster may elect to control wind speed in a specified area or to center it upon himself for a mobile radius of effect.

sp-07381.description_en: As Predict Weather V, except the caster has a 95% chance of predicting the weather over a period equal to his level divided by five (round down) in days.

sp-07382.description_en: As Waveshield, except the caster may elect to control the waves in a specified area or to center it upon himself for a mobile radius of effect.

sp-07383.description_en: As Command Winds, except the caster may indicate the weather conditions in the area, modifying wind speeds by +/- 1 mph per level, and setting the intensity of precipitation, fog, cloud cover, etc. Caster may call for shifts in the patterns by concentrating, but any change will take at least d10 minutes. The caster may elect to control the weather in a specified area or to center it upon himself for a mobile radius of effect.

sp-07384.description_en: The caster can summon the forces of nature in a fierce sea storm with wind speeds up to twice his level, waves of 20'-50', and heavy rain. The storm can be delayed up to 1 hour per level. After the storm is summoned, it will dissipate normally. This spell may only be cast at sea (at least 1 mile away from a coastline).

sp-07385.description_en: As Command Current I, except the speed of the ship or boat can be increased by 250' per round (approximately 15 miles per hour).

sp-07386.description_en: As Command Weather, except for the area of effect and range.

sp-07387.description_en: As Command Storms, except for the area of effect and range.

sp-00404.description_en: Caster determines the realm, element and spell classification of target spell.

sp-00405.description_en: Caster channels elemental energy from his Main Element at target spell. This effect nullifies up to a 2nd level class “E” spell from the caster's Source Element. Caster must make a successful Directed Spells maneuver (i.e., make an attack against the caster of the target spell using the appropriate elemental attack table). If the attack is successful (delivers hits) then the maneuver succeeds in countering the spell the same round it is cast. If the spell is not cast directly at the caster then the caster must spend an additional 20% action to monitor spell casting. Target spell receives no RR.

sp-00406.description_en: As Counter Source II, except it affects any element within the caster's elemental Triad.

sp-00407.description_en: Drains power from a spell of the caster's main element. For every 10% failure spell is reduced by one level. If spell level is reduced to 0 then the spell is cancelled. Otherwise the effect of the spell is reduced accordingly (GM's discretion). For most spells, this would reduce the caster's level for RRs, spell duration, etc.… Caster gains 1 PP for every 2 levels by which the spell is reduced.

sp-00408.description_en: As Counter Source II, except it affects up to 5th level spells.

sp-00409.description_en: As Counter Source II, except it affects spells from the elements not of the caster's triad.

sp-00410.description_en: As Counter Triad II, except up to 5th level spells can be affected.

sp-00411.description_en: Converts a spell of the caster's Source Element to change its elemental make-up to that of the caster's Main Element. Effects are up to the GM.

sp-00412.description_en: As Counter Source II, except it affects 7th level spells.

sp-00413.description_en: As Counter Element II, except up to 5th level spells can be affected.

sp-00414.description_en: As Counter Triad II, except up to 7th level spells can be affected.

sp-00415.description_en: [RR Mod: -10] As Power Drain I, except spell level is reduced by 1 for every 5% failure.

sp-00416.description_en: As Counter Source II, except it affects 10th level spells.

sp-00417.description_en: As Counter Element II, except up to 7th level spells can be affected.

sp-00418.description_en: As Counter Triad II, except up to 10th level spells can be affected.

sp-00419.description_en: [RR Mod: -20] As Power Drain I, except spell level is reduced by 2 for every 5% failure.

sp-00420.description_en: As Counter Source II, except it affects 15th level spells.

sp-00421.description_en: Allows the caster to store a Counter Spell from this list. Spell is activated when the first spell of the appropriate type targets or affects the caster. No other spells from this list may be cast while this spell is active; doing so dissipates this spell. If a Counter Element spell is used the caster must specify the Element that this spell is waiting for.

sp-00422.description_en: As Counter Element II, except up to 10th level spells can be affected.

sp-00423.description_en: As Counter Triad II, except up to 15th level spells can be affected.

sp-00424.description_en: As Counter Source II, except any level of spell may be affected. PP's spent on this spell must be greater than or equal to the spell to be countered. Increasing Power Points increases the level of this spell. Adjust the spell casting rolls accordingly.
